sentences.zh: 王冕，字服周，洛陽人。

translations.literal: Wang Mian, style name Fuzhou, was a native of Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mian, whose style was Fuzhou, came from Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 正德十二年進士。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of the Zhengde reign he passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: He became a jinshi in the twelfth year of Zhengde.

sentences.zh: 除萬安知縣。

translations.literal: He was appointed magistrate of Wan'an.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed magistrate of Wan'an.

sentences.zh: 宸濠反，長吏多奔竄。

translations.literal: When Prince of Ning Chenhao rebelled, many senior officials fled.
translations.idiomatic: When the Prince of Ning, Zhu Chenhao, rebelled, many senior officials fled in panic.

sentences.zh: 冕募勇壯士，得死士數千人，從王守仁攻復南昌。

translations.literal: Mian recruited brave and stalwart men, obtained several thousand men willing to die, and followed Wang Shouren to attack and recover Nanchang.
translations.idiomatic: Mian raised brave men and gathered several thousand who were ready to die, then followed Wang Shouren in the campaign to retake Nanchang.

sentences.zh: 宸濠解安慶圍，還救，至鄱陽湖，兩軍相拒。

translations.literal: Chenhao lifted the siege of Anqing and returned to the rescue; when he reached Poyang Lake the two armies confronted each other.
translations.idiomatic: Chenhao raised the siege of Anqing and marched back to relieve his forces; at Poyang Lake the two armies faced off.

sentences.zh: 濠盡出金制犒士，殊死戰，官軍不利。

translations.literal: Hao spent all his gold to reward the troops; they fought to the death, and the government army fared poorly.
translations.idiomatic: Chenhao poured out all his gold to reward his troops, who fought desperately, and the government forces began to lose ground.

sentences.zh: 冕密白守仁，以小艇實葦於中，擬建昌人語，就賊艦，乘風舉火。

translations.literal: Mian secretly reported to Shouren, loaded small boats with reeds, imitated the speech of men from Jianchang, approached the rebel ships, and set fire as the wind rose.
translations.idiomatic: Mian secretly advised Shouren to load small boats with reeds, send men speaking in the Jianchang dialect toward the rebel fleet, and set the boats ablaze on the wind.

sentences.zh: 濠兵大驚，遂潰敗，焚溺死者無算。

translations.literal: Hao's troops were greatly alarmed and then routed; those burned or drowned were beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: Chenhao's troops panicked and broke; countless men were burned or drowned.

sentences.zh: 濠易舟，挾宮人遁。

translations.literal: Hao changed boats and fled, taking palace women with him.
translations.idiomatic: Chenhao changed boats and fled, taking palace women with him.

sentences.zh: 冕部卒棹漁舟，追執之。

translations.literal: Mian's subordinates rowed fishing boats, pursued him, and captured him.
translations.idiomatic: Men under Mian's command rowed out in fishing boats, overtook him, and seized him.

sentences.zh: 宸濠平，守仁封新建伯，而冕未及敘，坐他事落職。

translations.literal: When Chenhao's rebellion was suppressed, Shouren was enfeoffed as Marquis of Xinjian, but Mian had not yet been rewarded for merit and was dismissed on other grounds.
translations.idiomatic: After Chenhao's rebellion was put down, Shouren was enfeoffed as Marquis of Xinjian, but Mian had not yet been rewarded and was removed from office over another matter.

sentences.zh: 既而錄前功，擢兵部主事，巡視山海關。

translations.literal: Later his earlier merit was recorded, and he was promoted to secretary in the Ministry of War and sent to inspect Shanhaiguan.
translations.idiomatic: Later his earlier service was recognized, and he was promoted to secretary in the Ministry of War and assigned to inspect Shanhaiguan.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖三年十二月，遼東妖賊陸雄、李真等作亂，突入關。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the third year of Jiajing, the demonic bandits Lu Xiong, Li Zhen, and others of Liaodong rebelled and burst through the pass.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the third year of Jiajing, the rebel bandits Lu Xiong, Li Zhen, and others in Liaodong rose in revolt and broke into the pass.

sentences.zh: 侍吏欲扶冕趨避，冕不可，曰：「吾有親在。

translations.literal: Attendants wished to support Mian and hurry away to safety, but he would not allow it and said, "I have a parent here.
translations.idiomatic: Attendants tried to help Mian flee, but he refused, saying, "I have a parent here.

sentences.zh: 」急趨母所，執兵以衛。

translations.literal: " He hurried to his mother's place, took up arms, and guarded her.
translations.idiomatic: " He rushed to his mother, took up arms, and stood guard over her.

sentences.zh: 賊至，母被傷，冕奮前救之，被執。

translations.literal: When the bandits arrived, his mother was wounded; Mian rushed forward to save her and was captured.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels arrived, his mother was wounded; Mian rushed forward to save her and was seized.

sentences.zh: 脅以刃，大罵，遂見害。

translations.literal: They threatened him with blades; he cursed them loudly and was then killed.
translations.idiomatic: They threatened him with blades; he cursed them fiercely and was killed.

sentences.zh: 詔贈光祿少卿，有司祠祀。

translations.literal: An edict posthumously granted him Vice Director of the Imperial Household and ordered the local authorities to offer sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: An edict posthumously made him Vice Director of the Imperial Household, and the local authorities were ordered to offer sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 世宗嗣位之歲，寧津盜起，轉掠至德平。

translations.literal: In the year the Shizong emperor succeeded to the throne, bandits rose in Ningjin and ranged as far as Deping.
translations.idiomatic: In the year the Jiajing emperor took the throne, bandits rose in Ningjin and spread their raids as far as Deping.

sentences.zh: 知縣龔諒率吏民禦之，力屈，被殺。

translations.literal: Magistrate Gong Liang led clerks and people to resist them; his strength gave out and he was killed.
translations.idiomatic: Magistrate Gong Liang led officials and townspeople to resist them; when his force was exhausted he was killed.

sentences.zh: 贈濟南通判，恤其家。

translations.literal: He was posthumously made Assistant Prefect of Jining, and his family was granted relief.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Assistant Prefect of Jining, and his family received relief.

sentences.zh: 陳聞詩

translations.literal: Chen Wenshi
translations.idiomatic: Chen Wenshi

sentences.zh: 陳聞詩，字廷訓，柘城人。

translations.literal: Chen Wenshi, style name Tingxun, was a native of Zhecheng.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Wenshi, whose style was Tingxun, came from Zhecheng.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖中舉於鄉，以親老，絕意仕進。

translations.literal: In the Jiajing reign he passed the provincial examination; because his parents were old, he gave up all thought of official advancement.
translations.idiomatic: During the Jiajing reign he passed the provincial examination, but with elderly parents at home he abandoned any ambition for office.

sentences.zh: 親歿，居喪哀毀。

translations.literal: When his parents died, he observed mourning with grief that wasted his body.
translations.idiomatic: After his parents died, he mourned them with such grief that he wasted away.

sentences.zh: 三十二年秋，賊師尚詔陷歸德，聞聞詩名，欲劫為帥。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the thirty-second year, the bandit leader Shang Zhao captured Guide; hearing Wenshi's reputation, he wished to seize him and make him commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the thirty-second year, the rebel leader Shang Zhao took Guide; hearing of Wenshi's reputation, he wanted to seize him and make him their commander.

sentences.zh: 已，陷柘城，擁之至，誘說百端，不屈。

translations.literal: Later, when Zhecheng fell, they brought him there and tried every persuasion, but he would not yield.
translations.idiomatic: Later, when Zhecheng fell, they brought him there and tried every argument, but he would not submit.

sentences.zh: 引其家數人斬之，曰：「不從，滅而族。

translations.literal: They led out several members of his family and beheaded them, saying, "If you do not obey, we will exterminate your clan.
translations.idiomatic: They brought out several members of his family and beheaded them, saying, "If you refuse, we will wipe out your clan.

sentences.zh: 」聞詩紿曰：「必欲吾行，毋殺人，毋縱火。

translations.literal: " Wenshi deceived them, saying, "If you truly want me to go, do not kill people and do not set fires.
translations.idiomatic: " Wenshi deceived them, saying, "If you insist that I go with you, do not kill anyone and do not burn anything.

sentences.zh: 」賊許諾，擁以行。

translations.literal: " The bandits agreed and escorted him on the march.
translations.idiomatic: " The rebels agreed and marched him away under guard.

sentences.zh: 聞詩遂不食，至鹿邑自經死。

translations.literal: Wenshi then stopped eating, and when he reached Luyi he hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: Wenshi then refused all food, and when they reached Luyi he hanged himself.

sentences.zh: 董倫，歸德檢校也。

translations.literal: Dong Lun was an inspector of Guide.
translations.idiomatic: Dong Lun was an inspector at Guide.

sentences.zh: 尚詔入歸德，知府及守衛官皆遁。

translations.literal: When Shang Zhao entered Guide, the prefect and the garrison officers all fled.
translations.idiomatic: When Shang Zhao entered Guide, the prefect and the garrison officers all fled.

sentences.zh: 倫率民兵巷戰，被執，垂死猶手刃數賊。

translations.literal: Lun led militia in street fighting, was captured, and even near death still killed several bandits with his own hand.
translations.idiomatic: Lun led militiamen in street fighting, was captured, and even as he lay dying still killed several rebels with his own hand.

sentences.zh: 妻賈及童僕皆從死。

translations.literal: His wife Jia and the household servants all died with him.
translations.idiomatic: His wife Jia and the household servants all died with him.

sentences.zh: 詔贈聞詩鳳陽同知，倫歸德同知，並立祠死所。

translations.literal: An edict posthumously made Wenshi Assistant Prefect of Fengyang and Lun Assistant Prefect of Guide, and ordered shrines erected where they died.
translations.idiomatic: An edict posthumously made Wenshi Assistant Prefect of Fengyang and Lun Assistant Prefect of Guide, and shrines were erected where they died.

sentences.zh: 王鈇，字德威，順天人。

translations.literal: Wang Fu, style name Dewei, was a native of Shuntian.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Fu, whose style was Dewei, came from Shuntian.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖二十九年進士。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year of Jiajing he passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: He became a jinshi in the twenty-ninth year of Jiajing.

sentences.zh: 授常熟知縣。

translations.literal: He was appointed magistrate of Changshu.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed magistrate of Changshu.

sentences.zh: 濱海多大猾，匿亡命作奸，鈇悉貰其罪。

translations.literal: Along the coast there were many powerful scoundrels who harbored fugitives and committed crimes; Fu pardoned them all.
translations.idiomatic: The coastal region had many powerful ruffians who sheltered fugitives and committed crimes; Fu pardoned them all.

sentences.zh: 倭患起，鈇語諸猾曰：「何以報我？

translations.literal: When the pirate threat arose, Fu said to the scoundrels, "How will you repay me?
translations.idiomatic: When the pirate threat arose, Fu said to the ruffians, "How will you repay me?

sentences.zh: 」咸請效死，於是立耆長，部署子弟得數百人，合防卒訓練。

translations.literal: " All asked to serve unto death; he then established elders, deployed sons and younger men to the number of several hundred, and combined them with garrison troops for training.
translations.idiomatic: " They all offered to die in his service; he then appointed village elders, mustered several hundred local men, and combined them with garrison troops for training.

sentences.zh: 縣故無城，鈇率士卒城之。

translations.literal: The county originally had no wall; Fu led soldiers and laborers to build one.
translations.idiomatic: The county had no wall; Fu led soldiers and laborers to build one.

sentences.zh: 倭來薄，數禦卻之。

translations.literal: When pirates came and pressed close, he repeatedly drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: When pirates approached, he drove them back again and again.

sentences.zh: 已，自三丈浦分掠常熟、江陰。

translations.literal: Later, from Sanzhangpu they divided forces to raid Changshu and Jiangyin.
translations.idiomatic: Later the pirates split off from Sanzhangpu to raid Changshu and Jiangyin.

sentences.zh: 參政任環令鈇與指揮孔燾分統官民兵三千，破其寨，斬首百五十有奇，焚二十七艘，余倭皆遁。

translations.literal: Vice Commissioner Ren Huan ordered Fu and Commander Kong Yan to divide command of three thousand government troops and militia, broke their camp, beheaded more than one hundred fifty, burned twenty-seven ships, and the remaining pirates all fled.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Commissioner Ren Huan ordered Fu and Commander Kong Yan to divide command of three thousand government troops and militia; they broke the pirate camp, took more than one hundred fifty heads, burned twenty-seven ships, and the rest fled.

sentences.zh: 復掠勞縣，將由尚湖還海。

translations.literal: They again raided Lao County and were about to return to the sea by way of Shanghu Lake.
translations.idiomatic: They raided Lao County again and were preparing to return to the sea via Shanghu Lake.

sentences.zh: 鈇憤曰：「賊尚敢涉吾地邪！

translations.literal: Fu said in anger, "The bandits still dare to cross our territory!
translations.idiomatic: Fu said angrily, "The pirates still dare to cross our territory!

sentences.zh: 必擊殺之。」

translations.literal: We must strike and kill them."
translations.idiomatic: We must strike and kill them."

sentences.zh: 會邑人錢泮，字鳴聲者，以江西參政里居，仇倭爇其父柩，力從臾贊鈇。

translations.literal: It happened that a townsman, Qian Pan, style name Mingsheng, who had served as Jiangxi Vice Commissioner and was living at home, bore a grudge because pirates had burned his father's coffin; he vigorously urged and supported Fu.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Qian Pan of the county, whose style was Mingsheng, a former Jiangxi Vice Commissioner living in retirement, hated the pirates for burning his father's coffin and strongly urged Fu on.

sentences.zh: 乃用小艇數十躡倭，倭夾擊之隘中，獨耆長數人從，皆力鬪死。

translations.literal: They then used several dozen small boats to pursue the pirates; the pirates attacked them from both sides in a narrow place, and only a few elders followed, all fighting to the death.
translations.idiomatic: They took several dozen small boats in pursuit; the pirates ambushed them in a narrow passage, and only a few village elders followed—all fought to the death.

sentences.zh: 鈇陷淖，瞋目大呼，腹中刃死。

translations.literal: Fu sank into the mud, glared and shouted loudly, and died with a blade in his belly.
translations.idiomatic: Fu sank into the mud, glared and shouted, and died with a blade in his belly.

sentences.zh: 泮被數槍，殺三賊而死。

translations.literal: Pan was struck by several spears, killed three bandits, and died.
translations.idiomatic: Pan was struck by several spears, killed three pirates, and died.

sentences.zh: 時三十四年五月也。

translations.literal: This was in the fifth month of the thirty-fourth year.
translations.idiomatic: This was in the fifth month of the thirty-fourth year.

sentences.zh: 詔贈泮光祿卿，鈇太僕少卿，並蔭錦衣世百戶，遣官諭祭，立祠死所，歲時奉祀。

translations.literal: An edict posthumously made Pan Director of the Imperial Household and Fu Vice Director of the Imperial Stud, granted hereditary hundred-household posts in the Embroidered Uniform Guard to both, sent officials to announce sacrifice, and ordered shrines erected where they died with seasonal offerings.
translations.idiomatic: An edict posthumously made Pan Director of the Imperial Household and Fu Vice Director of the Imperial Stud, granted both hereditary hundred-household posts in the Embroidered Uniform Guard, sent officials to offer sacrifice, and ordered shrines built where they died with seasonal rites.

sentences.zh: 錢錞，字鳴叔，鐘祥人。

translations.literal: Qian Chun, style name Mingshu, was a native of Zhongxiang.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Chun, whose style was Mingshu, came from Zhongxiang.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖二十九年進士。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year of Jiajing he passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: He became a jinshi in the twenty-ninth year of Jiajing.

sentences.zh: 授江陰知縣。

translations.literal: He was appointed magistrate of Jiangyin.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed magistrate of Jiangyin.

sentences.zh: 初至官，倭已熾。

translations.literal: When he first took office, the pirate threat was already severe.
translations.idiomatic: When he first took office, the pirate threat was already severe.

sentences.zh: 三十三年入犯，鄉民奔入城者萬計，兵備道王從古不納。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year they invaded; tens of thousands of villagers fled into the city, but Military Intendant Wang Congu refused to admit them.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year the pirates invaded; tens of thousands of villagers fled into the city, but Military Intendant Wang Congu refused to let them in.

sentences.zh: 錞曰：「民死不救，守空城奚為！

translations.literal: Chun said, "If the people die and we do not save them, what is the use of holding an empty city!
translations.idiomatic: Chun said, "If the people die and we do not save them, what is the point of holding an empty city!

sentences.zh: 」遂開門縱之入，而身自搏戰於斜橋，三戰卻之。

translations.literal: " He then opened the gates and let them in, while he himself fought at Xieqiao Bridge and drove the enemy back in three engagements.
translations.idiomatic: " He opened the gates and let them in, then fought in person at Xieqiao Bridge and drove the enemy back in three battles.

sentences.zh: 明年六月，倭據蔡涇閘，分眾犯塘頭。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the following year, pirates occupied the Caijing Sluice and divided forces to attack Tangtou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the following year, pirates held the Caijing Sluice and split their forces to attack Tangtou.

sentences.zh: 錞提狼兵戰九里山，薄暮，雷雨大作，伏四起，狼兵悉奔，錞戰死。

translations.literal: Chun led Lang troops to fight at Jiuli Mountain; at dusk a great thunderstorm broke out, ambushes rose on every side, the Lang troops all fled, and Chun died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Chun led Lang troops into battle at Jiuli Mountain; at dusk a thunderstorm broke, ambushes sprang up everywhere, the Lang troops fled, and Chun was killed.

sentences.zh: 唐一岑

translations.literal: Tang Yicen
translations.idiomatic: Tang Yicen

sentences.zh: 時唐一岑知崇明縣，建新城成，議徙居，為千戶高才、翟欽所沮。

translations.literal: At that time Tang Yicen was magistrate of Chongming; the new city wall was completed and a move was proposed, but it was blocked by Battalion Commanders Gao Cai and Zhai Qin.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Tang Yicen was magistrate of Chongming; when the new city wall was finished and a move was proposed, Battalion Commanders Gao Cai and Zhai Qin blocked it.

sentences.zh: 倭突入，一岑戰且詈，遂為亂軍所殺。

translations.literal: Pirates burst in; Yicen fought and cursed, and was then killed by the disorderly troops.
translations.idiomatic: Pirates burst in; Yicen fought and cursed them, and was killed by the disorderly troops.

sentences.zh: 詔贈錞、一岑光祿少卿，錞世蔭錦衣百戶，岑蔭國子生，並建祠祀。

translations.literal: An edict posthumously made Chun and Yicen Vice Directors of the Imperial Household, granted Chun a hereditary hundred-household post in the Embroidered Uniform Guard and Yicen enrollment as a student of the Imperial Academy, and ordered shrines built for sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: An edict posthumously made Chun and Yicen Vice Directors of the Imperial Household, granted Chun a hereditary hundred-household post in the Embroidered Uniform Guard and Yicen enrollment in the Imperial Academy, and ordered shrines built for them.

sentences.zh: 朱裒，字崇晉，鄖西人。

translations.literal: Zhu Bao, style name Chongjin, was a native of Yunxi.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Bao, whose style was Chongjin, came from Yunxi.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖中舉於鄉，署鞏縣教諭事。

translations.literal: In the Jiajing reign he passed the provincial examination and served as acting instructor of Gong County.
translations.idiomatic: During the Jiajing reign he passed the provincial examination and served as acting instructor of Gong County.

sentences.zh: 遷武功知縣，抑豪強，祛積弊，關中呼為鐵漢。

translations.literal: He was transferred to magistrate of Wugong, suppressed powerful families, removed accumulated abuses, and was called the Iron Man in Guanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to magistrate of Wugong, suppressed powerful families, cleared away long-standing abuses, and was called the Iron Man in Guanzhong.

sentences.zh: 遷揚州同知，吏無敢索民一錢。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Assistant Prefect of Yangzhou; no clerk dared demand a single coin from the people.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Assistant Prefect of Yangzhou; no clerk dared extract a single coin from the people.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，倭入犯，擊敗之沙河，殲其酋，還所掠牲畜甚眾。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year pirates invaded; he defeated them at Shahe, destroyed their chieftain, and recovered a great many stolen livestock.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fourth year pirates invaded; he defeated them at Shahe, killed their chieftain, and recovered a great many stolen livestock.

sentences.zh: 未幾，復大至，薄城東門。

translations.literal: Before long they came again in force and pressed close to the east gate.
translations.idiomatic: Before long they returned in force and pressed the east gate.

sentences.zh: 督兵奮擊，兵潰，死焉。

translations.literal: He directed troops in fierce fighting; the army broke and he died there.
translations.idiomatic: He led the troops in fierce fighting; the army broke and he was killed.

sentences.zh: 贈左參政，錄一子。

translations.literal: He was posthumously made Left Vice Commissioner and one son was granted office.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Left Vice Commissioner and one son was granted office.

sentences.zh: 明年，倭犯無為州，同知齊恩率舟師敗倭於圌山北等港，斬首百餘級。

translations.literal: The next year pirates attacked Wuwei Prefecture; Assistant Prefect Qi En led a naval force and defeated pirates at the harbors north of Tushan, taking more than one hundred heads.
translations.idiomatic: The next year pirates attacked Wuwei Prefecture; Assistant Prefect Qi En led a fleet and defeated them at the harbors north of Tushan, taking more than one hundred heads.

sentences.zh: 子嵩，年十八，最驍勇，擊倭至安港，伏發被圍，恩家二十餘人俱力戰死，惟嵩等三人獲全。

translations.literal: His son Song, eighteen years old and the most valiant, pursued pirates to Angang; an ambush sprang up and they were surrounded; more than twenty of En's family all fought to the death, and only Song and two others escaped.
translations.idiomatic: His son Song, eighteen and the most valiant, pursued pirates to Angang; an ambush sprang up and they were surrounded; more than twenty of En's family fought to the death, and only Song and two others survived.

sentences.zh: 贈恩光祿丞，錄一子，厚恤其家，建祠祀之。

translations.literal: En was posthumously made Assistant Director of the Imperial Household; one son was granted office, his family richly compensated, and a shrine was built for sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: En was posthumously made Assistant Director of the Imperial Household; one son was granted office, his family was richly compensated, and a shrine was built for him.

sentences.zh: 孫鏜，莒州人。

translations.literal: Sun Tang was a native of Juzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Tang came from Juzhou.

sentences.zh: 商販吳、越。

translations.literal: He traded in Wu and Yue.
translations.idiomatic: He traded in the Wu and Yue region.

sentences.zh: 倭擾松江，謁郡守自請輸貲佐軍。

translations.literal: When pirates harassed Songjiang, he visited the prefect and volunteered to contribute funds to support the army.
translations.idiomatic: When pirates harassed Songjiang, he visited the prefect and volunteered to contribute funds for the army.

sentences.zh: 守薦之參政翁大立，試以只刀，若飛，錄為士兵。

translations.literal: The prefect recommended him to Vice Commissioner Weng Dali, who tested him with a single knife—it flew like lightning—and enrolled him as a soldier.
translations.idiomatic: The prefect recommended him to Vice Commissioner Weng Dali, who tested him with a single knife—it moved like lightning—and enrolled him as a soldier.

sentences.zh: 擊走倭，出參政任環圍中。

translations.literal: He drove off pirates and rescued Vice Commissioner Ren Huan from encirclement.
translations.idiomatic: He drove off pirates and rescued Vice Commissioner Ren Huan from encirclement.

sentences.zh: 遣人還莒，括家貲，悉召里兒為爪牙，吳中倚鏜若長城。

translations.literal: He sent men back to Ju to gather his family wealth, summoned all the local youths as his followers, and Wu relied on Tang as on the Great Wall.
translations.idiomatic: He sent men back to Ju to gather his family wealth, mustered local youths as his followers, and Wu relied on Tang as on a great wall.

sentences.zh: 倭舟渡泖滸，鏜突出，酣戰竟日，援兵不至，還至石湖橋，半渡，伏大起，鏜墮死，中刃死。

translations.literal: Pirate ships crossed the Maoxu; Tang burst forth and fought fiercely all day; reinforcements did not arrive; returning to Shihu Bridge, halfway across, a great ambush rose; Tang fell and died, struck by blades.
translations.idiomatic: Pirate ships crossed the Maoxu; Tang burst forth and fought all day; reinforcements never came; on the return at Shihu Bridge, halfway across, a great ambush rose; Tang fell and was killed by blades.

sentences.zh: 贈光祿丞，錄一子，亦建祠祀。

translations.literal: He was posthumously made Assistant Director of the Imperial Household; one son was granted office and a shrine was also built for sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Assistant Director of the Imperial Household; one son was granted office and a shrine was built for him.

sentences.zh: 杜槐，字茂卿，茲溪人。

translations.literal: Du Huai, style name Maoqing, was a native of Cixi.
translations.idiomatic: Du Huai, whose style was Maoqing, came from Cixi.

sentences.zh: 倜儻任俠。

translations.literal: He was free-spirited and chivalrous.
translations.idiomatic: He was free-spirited and chivalrous.

sentences.zh: 倭寇至，縣僉其父文明為部長，令團結鄉勇。

translations.literal: When pirates arrived, the county appointed his father Wenming as section chief and ordered the rallying of village braves.
translations.idiomatic: When pirates arrived, the county appointed his father Wenming as section chief and ordered village braves rallied.

sentences.zh: 槐傷父老，以身任之，數敗倭。

translations.literal: Huai grieved that his father was old and took the task upon himself, repeatedly defeating pirates.
translations.idiomatic: Huai grieved that his father was old and took the task on himself, repeatedly defeating pirates.

sentences.zh: 副使劉起安委槐守餘姚、慈溪、定海。

translations.literal: Vice Commissioner Liu Qi'an entrusted Huai to defend Yuyao, Cixi, and Dinghai.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Commissioner Liu Qi'an entrusted Huai with the defense of Yuyao, Cixi, and Dinghai.

sentences.zh: 遇倭定海之白沙，一日戰十三合，斬三十餘人，馘一酋，身被數槍，墮馬死。

translations.literal: He met pirates at Baisha in Dinghai; in one day they fought thirteen engagements; he beheaded more than thirty men and took one chieftain's head; his body was struck by several spears and he fell from his horse and died.
translations.idiomatic: He met pirates at Baisha in Dinghai; in one day they fought thirteen engagements; he killed more than thirty men and took one chieftain's head; struck by several spears, he fell from his horse and died.

sentences.zh: 文明擊倭鳴鶴場，斬酋一人，倭驚遁，稱為杜將軍。

translations.literal: Wenming fought pirates at Minghechang, beheaded one chieftain, and the pirates fled in alarm, calling him General Du.
translations.idiomatic: Wenming fought pirates at Minghechang, killed one chieftain, and the pirates fled in alarm, calling him General Du.

sentences.zh: 無何，追至奉化楓樹嶺，戰歿。

translations.literal: Before long, pursuing to Fengshuling in Fenghua, he died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Before long, pursuing to Maple Tree Ridge in Fenghua, he was killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 文明贈府經歷，槐贈光祿丞，建祠並祀，蔭槐子國子生。

translations.literal: Wenming was posthumously made prefectural assistant; Huai was posthumously made Assistant Director of the Imperial Household; a shrine was built for joint sacrifice, and Huai's son was granted enrollment in the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: Wenming was posthumously made prefectural assistant; Huai was posthumously made Assistant Director of the Imperial Household; a shrine was built for both, and Huai's son was enrolled in the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 黃釧，字珍夫，安溪人。

translations.literal: Huang Chuan, style name Zhenfu, was a native of Anxi.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Chuan, whose style was Zhenfu, came from Anxi.

sentences.zh: 由舉人歷官溫州同知。

translations.literal: From provincial graduate he rose to Assistant Prefect of Wenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: From provincial graduate he rose to Assistant Prefect of Wenzhou.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖三十四年，倭入犯，釧擊走之。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year of Jiajing pirates invaded and Chuan drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fourth year of Jiajing pirates invaded and Chuan drove them off.

sentences.zh: 知倭必復來，日夜為備。

translations.literal: Knowing pirates would surely return, he prepared day and night.
translations.idiomatic: Knowing the pirates would return, he prepared day and night.

sentences.zh: 又三年，倭果大至。

translations.literal: Three years later, pirates indeed came in force.
translations.idiomatic: Three years later, pirates came in force as he had expected.

sentences.zh: 釧出城逆擊，分軍為三，釧將中軍，其二軍帥皆紈袴子，約左右應援。

translations.literal: Chuan went out of the city to meet them, divided the army into three, commanded the center himself, and the two other commanders were silk-trousered youths who agreed to support him on the flanks.
translations.idiomatic: Chuan went out to meet them, divided his force into three, commanded the center himself, and the two flank commanders were pampered youths who agreed to support him.

sentences.zh: 及與倭遇，倭遣眾分掩二軍，而以銳卒當中軍。

translations.literal: When they met the pirates, the pirates sent forces to envelop the two flanks and opposed the center with elite troops.
translations.idiomatic: When they met the pirates, the pirates sent forces to envelop the flanks and opposed the center with elite troops.

sentences.zh: 釧發勁弩巨炮，戰良久，倭方不支，二軍帥望敵而潰。

translations.literal: Chuan deployed powerful crossbows and great cannon; after fighting a long time the pirates began to fail, but the two flank commanders fled at the sight of the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Chuan deployed powerful crossbows and great cannon; after a long fight the pirates began to fail, but the two flank commanders fled at the sight of the enemy.

sentences.zh: 倭合兵擊釧，釧腹背受敵，遂被執。

translations.literal: The pirates combined forces to attack Chuan; attacked front and rear, he was captured.
translations.idiomatic: The pirates combined forces against Chuan; attacked from front and rear, he was captured.

sentences.zh: 脅之降，不屈，責以金贖，釧笑且罵曰：「爾不知黃大夫不愛錢邪！

translations.literal: They threatened him to surrender; he would not yield; they demanded gold for ransom; Chuan laughed and cursed, saying, "Do you not know that Grand Master Huang does not love money!
translations.idiomatic: They threatened him to surrender; he refused; they demanded gold for ransom; Chuan laughed and cursed, saying, "Do you not know that Grand Master Huang does not love money!

sentences.zh: 」倭怒，裸而寸斬之。

translations.literal: " The pirates were enraged, stripped him naked, and cut him to pieces.
translations.idiomatic: " The pirates were enraged, stripped him naked, and cut him to pieces.

sentences.zh: 子購屍不獲，具衣冠葬。

translations.literal: His son could not purchase the corpse and buried formal garments instead.
translations.idiomatic: His son could not recover the body and buried formal garments in his place.

sentences.zh: 事聞，贈浙江參議，官一子，有司建祠。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, he was posthumously made Zhejiang Vice Commissioner, one son was granted office, and the local authorities built a shrine.
translations.idiomatic: When the matter was reported, he was posthumously made Zhejiang Vice Commissioner, one son was granted office, and the local authorities built a shrine.

sentences.zh: 是年，倭陷福清，舉人陳見率眾禦之，與訓導鄔中涵被執，大罵而死。

translations.literal: That year pirates took Fuqing; provincial graduate Chen Jian led the people to resist; he and Instructor Wu Zhonghan were captured, cursed loudly, and died.
translations.idiomatic: That year pirates took Fuqing; provincial graduate Chen Jian led the people to resist; he and Instructor Wu Zhonghan were captured, cursed them fiercely, and died.

sentences.zh: 倭乘勝犯惠安，知縣番禺林咸拒守五晝夜，倭引去。

translations.literal: Pirates pressed their victory to attack Huian; Magistrate Lin Xian of Panyu held out for five days and nights and the pirates withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Pirates pressed their victory to attack Huian; Magistrate Lin Xian of Panyu held out for five days and nights and the pirates withdrew.

sentences.zh: 已，復至，咸擊之鴨山，窮追逐北，陷伏死。

translations.literal: Later they returned; Xian struck them at Yashan, pursued them to the limit, fell into an ambush, and died.
translations.idiomatic: Later they returned; Xian struck them at Duck Mountain, pursued them hard, fell into an ambush, and was killed.

sentences.zh: 贈泉州同知，賜祠，任一子。

translations.literal: He was posthumously made Assistant Prefect of Quanzhou, granted a shrine, and one son was granted office.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Assistant Prefect of Quanzhou, granted a shrine, and one son was granted office.

sentences.zh: 奚世亮

translations.literal: Xi Shiliang
translations.idiomatic: Xi Shiliang

sentences.zh: 其陷興化，延平同知奚世亮署府事，守逾月，城陷，力戰死。

translations.literal: When Xinghua fell, Yanping Assistant Prefect Xi Shiliang was acting prefect; he held out for more than a month; the city fell and he died fighting.
translations.idiomatic: When Xinghua fell, Yanping Assistant Prefect Xi Shiliang was acting prefect; he held out for more than a month; the city fell and he died fighting.

sentences.zh: 贈右參議，蔭子，賜葬。

translations.literal: He was posthumously made Right Vice Commissioner; a son was granted hereditary privilege and burial was granted.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Right Vice Commissioner; a son was granted hereditary privilege and burial honors.

sentences.zh: 世亮，字明仲，黃岡人。

translations.literal: Shiliang, style name Mingzhong, was a native of Huanggang.
translations.idiomatic: Shiliang, whose style was Mingzhong, came from Huanggang.

sentences.zh: 先是，三十一年，台州知事溧水武暐追倭釣魚嶺，力戰死，上官不以聞。

translations.literal: Earlier, in the thirty-first year, Taizhou Assistant Magistrate Wu Wei of Lishui pursued pirates to Diaoyu Ridge, fought fiercely, and died; his superiors did not report it.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, in the thirty-first year, Taizhou Assistant Magistrate Wu Wei of Lishui pursued pirates to Fishing Ridge, fought fiercely, and died; his superiors did not report it.

sentences.zh: 其子尚寶訴於朝，乃贈太僕丞，而蔭尚實為國子生。

translations.literal: His son Shangbao appealed to the court; Wu Wei was then posthumously made Assistant Director of the Imperial Stud and Shangshi was granted enrollment in the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: His son Shangbao appealed to the court; Wu Wei was then posthumously made Assistant Director of the Imperial Stud and Shangshi was enrolled in the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 王德，字汝修，永嘉人。

translations.literal: Wang De, style name Ruxiu, was a native of Yongjia.
translations.idiomatic: Wang De, whose style was Ruxiu, came from Yongjia.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖十七年進士。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year of Jiajing he passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: He became a jinshi in the seventeenth year of Jiajing.

sentences.zh: 歷戶科給事中。

translations.literal: He served as supervising secretary in the Revenue Section.
translations.idiomatic: He served as supervising secretary in the Revenue Section.

sentences.zh: 定國公徐延德丐無極諸縣閑田為業，且言私置莊田，不宜以災傷免賦。

translations.literal: Duke of Dingguo Xu Yande begged for idle lands in Wuji and other counties as his estate and also said that privately established manor lands should not be exempt from tax on grounds of disaster or crop failure.
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Dingguo Xu Yande petitioned for idle lands in Wuji and other counties as his estate and argued that privately established manor lands should not be exempt from tax on grounds of disaster or crop failure.

sentences.zh: 德抗疏劾之，俺答圍都城，屢陳軍國便宜，悉報可。

translations.literal: De submitted a memorial in opposition impeaching him; when Altan besieged the capital, he repeatedly presented timely proposals on military and state affairs, all approved.
translations.idiomatic: De submitted a memorial impeaching him; when Altan besieged the capital, he repeatedly presented timely proposals on military and state affairs, all of which were approved.

sentences.zh: 時城門盡閉，避難者不得入，號呼徹西內。

translations.literal: At that time all city gates were closed; refugees could not enter, and their cries reached the western inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: At that time all city gates were closed; refugees could not enter, and their cries reached the western inner palace.

sentences.zh: 德以為言，民始獲入。

translations.literal: De spoke on the matter, and the people were then allowed to enter.
translations.idiomatic: De spoke on the matter, and the people were then allowed to enter.

sentences.zh: 寇退，命募兵山東，所得悉驍勇，為諸道最。

translations.literal: When the invaders withdrew, he was ordered to recruit troops in Shandong; those obtained were all fierce and brave, the best of all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: When the invaders withdrew, he was ordered to recruit troops in Shandong; those he obtained were all fierce and brave—the best of any circuit.

sentences.zh: 還朝，會李默長吏部，怒德投刺倨，出為嶺南兵備僉事。

translations.literal: Returning to court, when Li Mo headed the Ministry of Personnel, he was angered that De's calling card was arrogant and sent him out as Lingnan Military Intendant.
translations.idiomatic: Returning to court, when Li Mo headed the Ministry of Personnel, he was angered that De's calling card was arrogant and sent him out as Lingnan Military Intendant.

sentences.zh: 與巡撫爭事，投劾徑歸。

translations.literal: He quarreled with the grand coordinator over affairs, submitted his resignation, and went straight home.
translations.idiomatic: He quarreled with the grand coordinator over affairs, submitted his resignation, and went straight home.

sentences.zh: 默復起吏部，用前憾，落職閑住。

translations.literal: Mo was again appointed to the Ministry of Personnel and, using old resentment, had De dismissed to live in retirement.
translations.idiomatic: Mo was again appointed to the Ministry of Personnel and, using old resentment, had De dismissed to live in retirement.

sentences.zh: 德鄉居，以倭亂，奉母居城中，傾貲募健兒為保障計。

translations.literal: De lived in his home district; because of pirate disorder he brought his mother to live in the city and spent his wealth recruiting strong youths for defense.
translations.idiomatic: De lived in his home district; because of pirate disorder he brought his mother to live in the city and spent his wealth recruiting strong youths for defense.

sentences.zh: 三十七年夏，倭自梅頭至，大掠。

translations.literal: In the summer of the thirty-seventh year pirates came from Meitou and raided extensively.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the thirty-seventh year pirates came from Meitou and raided extensively.

sentences.zh: 德偕族父沛督義兵擊之，宵遁。

translations.literal: De together with his clansman uncle Pei directed volunteer troops to attack them, and the pirates fled by night.
translations.idiomatic: De together with his clansman uncle Pei directed volunteer troops against them, and the pirates fled by night.

sentences.zh: 俄一舟突來犯，沛及族弟崇堯、崇修殲焉。

translations.literal: Soon a single boat suddenly came to attack; Pei and his clansmen younger brothers Chongyao and Chongxiu were destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Soon a single boat suddenly attacked; Pei and his clansmen younger brothers Chongyao and Chongxiu were killed.

sentences.zh: 亡何，倭復至，大掠。

translations.literal: Before long pirates returned and raided extensively.
translations.idiomatic: Before long pirates returned and raided extensively.

sentences.zh: 德憤怒，勒所部追襲至龍灣，軍敗，手射殺數人，罵賊死。

translations.literal: De in fury drove his followers in pursuit to Longwan; the army was defeated; he personally shot and killed several men, cursed the bandits, and died.
translations.idiomatic: De in fury drove his followers in pursuit to Longwan; the army was defeated; he personally shot and killed several men, cursed the pirates, and died.

sentences.zh: 然倭自是不敢越德鄉侵郡城矣。

translations.literal: From then on pirates did not dare cross De's home district to invade the prefectural city.
translations.idiomatic: From then on pirates did not dare cross De's home district to invade the prefectural city.

sentences.zh: 事聞，贈太僕少卿，世蔭錦衣百戶，立祠曰湣忠。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, he was posthumously made Vice Director of the Imperial Stud, granted a hereditary hundred-household post in the Embroidered Uniform Guard, and a shrine called Minzhong was built.
translations.idiomatic: When the matter was reported, he was posthumously made Vice Director of the Imperial Stud, granted a hereditary hundred-household post in the Embroidered Uniform Guard, and a shrine called Minzhong was built.

sentences.zh: 沛贈太僕丞，立祠，予蔭。

translations.literal: Pei was posthumously made Assistant Director of the Imperial Stud; a shrine was built and hereditary privilege granted.
translations.idiomatic: Pei was posthumously made Assistant Director of the Imperial Stud; a shrine was built and hereditary privilege granted.

sentences.zh: 汪一中

translations.literal: Wang Yizhong
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yizhong

sentences.zh: 汪一中，字正叔，歙人。

translations.literal: Wang Yizhong, style name Zhengshu, was a native of She.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yizhong, whose style was Zhengshu, came from She.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖二十三年進士。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year of Jiajing he passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: He became a jinshi in the twenty-third year of Jiajing.

sentences.zh: 由開封推官歷江西副使。

translations.literal: From Kaifeng reviewing official he rose to Jiangxi Vice Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: From Kaifeng reviewing official he rose to Jiangxi Vice Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 四十年，鄰境賊入寇，薄泰和。

translations.literal: In the fortieth year bandits from a neighboring region invaded and pressed close to Taihe.
translations.idiomatic: In the fortieth year bandits from a neighboring region invaded and pressed close to Taihe.

sentences.zh: 一中方宴，投著起曰：「賊鼓行而西，掩我不備，不早計，且無唯類，豈飲酒時乎！

translations.literal: Yizhong was at a banquet; he threw down his chopsticks and rose, saying, "The bandits are marching west, taking us unawares; if we do not plan early, none of us will survive—is this a time for drinking!
translations.idiomatic: Yizhong was at a banquet; he threw down his chopsticks and rose, saying, "The bandits are marching west and taking us unawares; if we do not act now, none of us will survive—is this a time for drinking!

sentences.zh: 」當路遂以討賊屬之。

translations.literal: " The authorities then entrusted him with suppressing the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: " The authorities then entrusted him with suppressing the bandits.

sentences.zh: 先是，泰和巡檢劉芳力戰死，賊怒磔其屍。

translations.literal: Earlier, Taihe Inspector Liu Fang had died fighting fiercely; the bandits in anger dismembered his corpse.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Taihe Inspector Liu Fang had died fighting fiercely; the bandits in anger dismembered his corpse.

sentences.zh: 一中至，率諸將吏祭曰：「爾職抱關，猶死疆事。

translations.literal: When Yizhong arrived, he led the generals and officials in sacrifice, saying, "Your duty was to guard the gate, yet you still died on the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: When Yizhong arrived, he led the generals and officials in sacrifice, saying, "Your duty was to guard the gate, yet you still died on the frontier.

sentences.zh: 吾待罪方面，不滅賊，何以生為！

translations.literal: I hold office in this region under a charge of guilt—if I do not destroy the bandits, what reason have I to live!
translations.idiomatic: I hold office in this region under a charge of guilt—if I do not destroy the bandits, what reason have I to live!

sentences.zh: 」遂誓師，列陣鼓之，俘五人，斬首以徇。

translations.literal: " He then swore in the army, drew up battle lines and beat the drums, captured five men, and beheaded them as a warning.
translations.idiomatic: " He then swore in the army, drew up battle lines and beat the drums, captured five men, and beheaded them as a warning.

sentences.zh: 旦日，陣如前，會賊至，左右軍皆潰，賊悉赴中軍，中軍亦潰。

translations.literal: The next day the formation was as before; when the bandits arrived, both flanks broke, the bandits all rushed the center, and the center also broke.
translations.idiomatic: The next day the formation was as before; when the bandits arrived, both flanks broke, the bandits all rushed the center, and the center broke as well.

sentences.zh: 一中躍馬當賊鋒，射殺二人，手刃一人，而左脅中槍二，臂中刃三，與指揮王應鵬、千戶唐鼎皆死。

translations.literal: Yizhong leaped on his horse to meet the bandit vanguard, shot and killed two men, killed one with his own hand, was struck by two spears in the left side and three blades in the arm, and died together with Commander Wang Yingpeng and Battalion Commander Tang Ding.
translations.idiomatic: Yizhong leaped on his horse to meet the bandit vanguard, shot and killed two men, killed one with his own hand, was struck by two spears in the left side and three blades in the arm, and died together with Commander Wang Yingpeng and Battalion Commander Tang Ding.

sentences.zh: 妻程投於井，家人出之，喪至，不食五日死。

translations.literal: His wife Cheng threw herself into a well; the family pulled her out; when the coffin arrived she ate nothing for five days and died.
translations.idiomatic: His wife Cheng threw herself into a well; the family pulled her out; when the coffin arrived she ate nothing for five days and died.

sentences.zh: 一中贈光祿卿，給祭葬，謚忠湣，妻程並贈恤如制。

translations.literal: Yizhong was posthumously made Director of the Imperial Household, granted sacrificial burial, and given the posthumous title Zhongmin; his wife Cheng was also granted compensation according to regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Yizhong was posthumously made Director of the Imperial Household, granted sacrificial burial, and given the posthumous title Zhongmin; his wife Cheng received compensation according to regulation.

sentences.zh: 蘇夢昜

translations.literal: Su Mengyi
translations.idiomatic: Su Mengyi

sentences.zh: 蘇夢昜，萬曆間，為雲南祿豐知縣。

translations.literal: Su Mengyi, during the Wanli reign, served as magistrate of Lufeng in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: Su Mengyi served as magistrate of Lufeng in Yunnan during the Wanli reign.

sentences.zh: 三十五年十二月，武定賊鳳騰霄反，圍雲南府城，轉寇祿豐。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the thirty-fifth year, the Wuding bandit Feng Tengxiao rebelled, besieged Yunnan prefectural city, and turned to raid Lufeng.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the thirty-fifth year, the Wuding bandit Feng Tengxiao rebelled, besieged Yunnan prefectural city, and turned to raid Lufeng.

sentences.zh: 夢昜率民兵出城力戰，賊退去。

translations.literal: Mengyi led militia out of the city to fight fiercely and the bandits withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Mengyi led militia out of the city to fight fiercely and the bandits withdrew.

sentences.zh: 明年元旦，方朝服祝厘，賊出不意襲陷其城，執之去，不屈死。

translations.literal: On New Year's Day the next year, while he was in court dress offering blessings, bandits unexpectedly attacked and took the city, seized him, and he died without yielding.
translations.idiomatic: On New Year's Day the next year, while he was in court dress offering blessings, bandits unexpectedly attacked and took the city, seized him, and he died without yielding.

sentences.zh: 贈光祿少卿，有司建祠，錄一子。

translations.literal: He was posthumously made Vice Director of the Imperial Household; the local authorities built a shrine and one son was granted office.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Vice Director of the Imperial Household; the local authorities built a shrine and one son was granted office.

sentences.zh: 韋宗孝

translations.literal: Wei Zongxiao
translations.idiomatic: Wei Zongxiao

sentences.zh: 當祿豐之未陷也，賊先犯嵩明州，吏目韋宗孝出禦而敗，合門死之。

translations.literal: Before Lufeng fell, bandits first attacked Songming Prefecture; Clerk Wei Zongxiao went out to resist and was defeated; the whole household died.
translations.idiomatic: Before Lufeng fell, bandits first attacked Songming Prefecture; Clerk Wei Zongxiao went out to resist and was defeated; the whole household died.

sentences.zh: 贈本州同知，蔭子入國學。

translations.literal: He was posthumously made Assistant Prefect of that prefecture and a son was granted enrollment in the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Assistant Prefect of that prefecture and a son was enrolled in the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 有龍旌者，趙州人，由歲貢生為嵩明州學正。

translations.literal: There was Long Jing, a native of Zhao Prefecture, who from annual tribute student became Director of Studies of Songming Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: There was Long Jing of Zhao Prefecture, who from annual tribute student became Director of Studies of Songming Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 賊薄城，被執，罵賊死。

translations.literal: When bandits pressed the city he was captured, cursed the bandits, and died.
translations.idiomatic: When bandits pressed the city he was captured, cursed them, and died.

sentences.zh: 贈國子博士。

translations.literal: He was posthumously made Erudite of the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Erudite of the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 張振德

translations.literal: Zhang Zhende
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhende

sentences.zh: 張振德，字季修，昆山人。

translations.literal: Zhang Zhende, style name Jixiu, was a native of Kunshan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhende, whose style was Jixiu, came from Kunshan.

sentences.zh: 祖情，從祖意，皆進士。

translations.literal: His grandfather Qing and his grand-uncle Yi were both jinshi.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Qing and his grand-uncle Yi were both jinshi.

sentences.zh: 情福建副使，意山東副使。

translations.literal: Qing was Fujian Vice Commissioner; Yi was Shandong Vice Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Qing was Fujian Vice Commissioner; Yi was Shandong Vice Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 振德由選貢生授四川興文知縣。

translations.literal: Zhende from selected tribute student was appointed magistrate of Xingwen in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhende, a selected tribute student, was appointed magistrate of Xingwen in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 縣故九絲蠻地，萬曆初，始建士墻數尺，戶不滿千。

translations.literal: The county was formerly Jiusi barbarian territory; at the beginning of Wanli an earthen wall several chi high was first built, and households numbered fewer than one thousand.
translations.idiomatic: The county was formerly Jiusi barbarian territory; at the beginning of Wanli an earthen wall several chi high was first built, and households numbered fewer than one thousand.

sentences.zh: 永寧宣撫奢崇明有異志，潛結奸人，掠賣子女。

translations.literal: Yongning Pacification Commissioner She Chongming had rebellious intentions, secretly joined with evil men, and plundered and sold men and women.
translations.idiomatic: Yongning Pacification Commissioner She Chongming had rebellious intentions, secretly joined with evil men, and plundered and sold men and women.

sentences.zh: 振德捕奸人，論配之，招還被掠者三百餘人。

translations.literal: Zhende captured the evil men, sentenced them to penal service, and brought back more than three hundred who had been seized.
translations.idiomatic: Zhende captured the evil men, sentenced them to penal service, and brought back more than three hundred who had been seized.

sentences.zh: 崇明賄以二千金，振德怒卻之，裂其牘。

translations.literal: Chongming bribed him with two thousand gold; Zhende angrily refused and tore up the document.
translations.idiomatic: Chongming bribed him with two thousand gold; Zhende angrily refused and tore up the document.

sentences.zh: 天啟元年方赴成都與鄉闈事，而崇明部將樊龍殺巡撫徐可求，副使駱日升、李繼周等。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianqi he had just gone to Chengdu for the provincial examination when Chongming's subordinate general Fan Long killed Grand Coordinator Xu Keqiu, Vice Commissioners Luo Risheng, Li Jizhou, and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tianqi he had just gone to Chengdu for the provincial examination when Chongming's subordinate general Fan Long killed Grand Coordinator Xu Keqiu, Vice Commissioners Luo Risheng, Li Jizhou, and others.

sentences.zh: 重慶知府章文炳、巴縣知縣段高選皆抗節死，賊遂據重慶。

translations.literal: Chongqing Prefect Zhang Wenbing and Ba County Magistrate Duan Gaoxuan both died resisting to the end; the bandits then held Chongqing.
translations.idiomatic: Chongqing Prefect Zhang Wenbing and Ba County Magistrate Duan Gaoxuan both died resisting to the end; the bandits then held Chongqing.

sentences.zh: 時振德兼署長寧，去賊稍遠，從者欲走長寧。

translations.literal: At that time Zhende was also acting for Changning, somewhat farther from the bandits; his followers wished to flee to Changning.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Zhende was also acting for Changning, somewhat farther from the bandits; his followers wished to flee to Changning.

sentences.zh: 振德曰：「守興文，正也。

translations.literal: Zhende said, "To hold Xingwen is the right course.
translations.idiomatic: Zhende said, "To hold Xingwen is the right course.

sentences.zh: 」疾趨入城。

translations.literal: " He hurried into the city.
translations.idiomatic: " He hurried into the city.

sentences.zh: 長寧主簿徐大禮與振德善，以騎來迎，振德卻之。

translations.literal: Changning Registrar Xu Dali was on good terms with Zhende and came on horseback to welcome him; Zhende refused.
translations.idiomatic: Changning Registrar Xu Dali was on good terms with Zhende and came on horseback to welcome him; Zhende refused.

sentences.zh: 督鄉兵與戰，不敵，退集居民城守。

translations.literal: He directed village troops to fight, could not prevail, withdrew, gathered the people, and defended the city.
translations.idiomatic: He directed village troops to fight, could not prevail, withdrew, gathered the people, and defended the city.

sentences.zh: 會大風雨，賊毀士城入。

translations.literal: A great wind and rain came; the bandits destroyed the earthen wall and entered.
translations.idiomatic: A great wind and rain came; the bandits destroyed the earthen wall and entered.

sentences.zh: 振德命妻錢及二女持一劍坐後堂，曰：「若輩死此，吾死前堂。

translations.literal: Zhende ordered his wife Qian and two daughters, each holding a sword, to sit in the rear hall, saying, "You shall die here; I shall die in the front hall.
translations.idiomatic: Zhende ordered his wife Qian and two daughters, each holding a sword, to sit in the rear hall, saying, "You shall die here; I shall die in the front hall.

sentences.zh: 」乃取二印繫肘後，北向拜曰：「臣奉職無狀，不能殺賊，惟一死明志。

translations.literal: " He then took two seals, tied them behind his elbows, bowed to the north, and said, "Your servant has performed his duty poorly and could not kill the bandits; only death can show my resolve.
translations.idiomatic: " He then took two seals, tied them behind his elbows, bowed to the north, and said, "Your servant has performed his duty poorly and could not kill the bandits; only death can show my resolve.

sentences.zh: 」妻女先伏劍死。

translations.literal: " His wife and daughters first fell on their swords and died.
translations.idiomatic: " His wife and daughters first fell on their swords and died.

sentences.zh: 乃命家人舉火，火熾自剄。

translations.literal: He then ordered the household to set fire; when the flames blazed he cut his own throat.
translations.idiomatic: He then ordered the household to set fire; when the flames blazed he cut his own throat.

sentences.zh: 一門死者十二人。

translations.literal: Twelve people of one household died.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve people of one household died.

sentences.zh: 賊至火所，見振德面如生，左手繫印，右手握刀，忿怒如赴敵狀，皆駭愕，羅拜而去。

translations.literal: When the bandits reached the fire they saw Zhende's face as if alive, his left hand bearing the seal, his right hand gripping a blade, angry as if rushing to battle; all were struck with awe, bowed in a circle, and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: When the bandits reached the fire they saw Zhende's face as if alive, his left hand bearing the seal, his right hand gripping a blade, angry as if rushing to battle; all were struck with awe, bowed in a circle, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 事聞，賜祭葬，贈光祿卿，謚烈湣。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, sacrificial burial was granted; he was posthumously made Director of the Imperial Household and given the posthumous title Liemin.
translations.idiomatic: When the matter was reported, sacrificial burial was granted; he was posthumously made Director of the Imperial Household and given the posthumous title Liemin.

sentences.zh: 敕有司建祠，世蔭錦衣千戶。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the local authorities to build a shrine and granted a hereditary thousand-household post in the Embroidered Uniform Guard.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the local authorities to build a shrine and granted a hereditary thousand-household post in the Embroidered Uniform Guard.

sentences.zh: 劉希文

translations.literal: Liu Xiwen
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xiwen

sentences.zh: 振德既死，興文教諭劉希文代署縣事。

translations.literal: After Zhende died, Xingwen Instructor Liu Xiwen acted in his place to administer county affairs.
translations.idiomatic: After Zhende died, Xingwen Instructor Liu Xiwen acted in his place to administer county affairs.

sentences.zh: 甫半載，賊復薄城，誓死不去。

translations.literal: Barely half a year later bandits again pressed the city; he swore to die and would not leave.
translations.idiomatic: Barely half a year later bandits again pressed the city; he swore to die and would not leave.

sentences.zh: 妻白亦慷慨願同死。

translations.literal: His wife Bai also vowed generously to die with him.
translations.idiomatic: His wife Bai also vowed generously to die with him.

sentences.zh: 城破，夫婦罵賊，並死。

translations.literal: When the city fell, husband and wife cursed the bandits and both died.
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell, husband and wife cursed the bandits and both died.

sentences.zh: 徐大禮

translations.literal: Xu Dali
translations.idiomatic: Xu Dali

sentences.zh: 大禮守長寧，城亦陷。

translations.literal: Dali held Changning; the city also fell.
translations.idiomatic: Dali held Changning; the city also fell.

sentences.zh: 大禮曰：「吾不可負張公。

translations.literal: Dali said, "I cannot fail Lord Zhang.
translations.idiomatic: Dali said, "I cannot fail Lord Zhang.

sentences.zh: 」一家四人仰藥死。

translations.literal: " Four members of one household took poison and died.
translations.idiomatic: " Four members of one household took poison and died.

sentences.zh: 贈重慶同知，世蔭百戶。

translations.literal: He was posthumously made Assistant Prefect of Chongqing and granted a hereditary hundred-household post.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Assistant Prefect of Chongqing and granted a hereditary hundred-household post.

sentences.zh: 章文炳

translations.literal: Zhang Wenbing
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Wenbing

sentences.zh: 文炳，長泰人。

translations.literal: Wenbing was a native of Changtai.
translations.idiomatic: Wenbing came from Changtai.

sentences.zh: 萬曆四十一年進士。

translations.literal: In the forty-first year of Wanli he passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: He became a jinshi in the forty-first year of Wanli.

sentences.zh: 歷戶部郎中，遷知府，治行廉潔，吏民愛之。

translations.literal: He served as secretary in the Ministry of Revenue, was transferred to prefect, administered with integrity and purity, and officials and people loved him.
translations.idiomatic: He served as secretary in the Ministry of Revenue, was transferred to prefect, administered with integrity and purity, and officials and people loved him.

sentences.zh: 賊既殺巡撫可求等，文炳罵賊亦被殺。

translations.literal: After the bandits had killed Grand Coordinator Keqiu and others, Wenbing cursed the bandits and was also killed.
translations.idiomatic: After the bandits had killed Grand Coordinator Keqiu and others, Wenbing cursed the bandits and was also killed.

sentences.zh: 後知其賢，為覓屍殯而歸之，喪出江上，夾岸皆大哭。

translations.literal: Later, knowing his worth, they sought his corpse, buried it, and returned it; when the coffin passed on the river, both banks wept loudly.
translations.idiomatic: Later, knowing his worth, they sought his corpse, buried it, and returned it; when the coffin passed on the river, both banks wept loudly.

sentences.zh: 贈太僕少卿，再贈太常卿，世蔭外衛副千戶。

translations.literal: He was posthumously made Vice Director of the Imperial Stud, then again made Director of the Imperial Sacrifices, and granted a hereditary deputy thousand-household post in an outer guard.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Vice Director of the Imperial Stud, then again made Director of the Imperial Sacrifices, and granted a hereditary deputy thousand-household post in an outer guard.

sentences.zh: 段高選

translations.literal: Duan Gaoxuan
translations.idiomatic: Duan Gaoxuan

sentences.zh: 高選，雲南劍川縣人。

translations.literal: Gaoxuan was a native of Jianchuan County in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: Gaoxuan came from Jianchuan County in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 萬曆四十七年進士。

translations.literal: In the forty-seventh year of Wanli he passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: He became a jinshi in the forty-seventh year of Wanli.

sentences.zh: 適在演武場，聞變，立遣吏歸印於署，厲聲叱賊。

translations.literal: He happened to be at the drill ground; hearing of the uprising, he immediately sent a clerk to return the seal to the office and shouted fiercely at the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: He happened to be at the drill ground; hearing of the uprising, he immediately sent a clerk to return the seal to the office and shouted fiercely at the bandits.

sentences.zh: 賊魁戒其下勿殺，而高選罵不絕聲，遂遇害。

translations.literal: The bandit chief warned his men not to kill, but Gaoxuan cursed without cease and was then killed.
translations.idiomatic: The bandit chief warned his men not to kill, but Gaoxuan cursed without cease and was then killed.

sentences.zh: 父汝元，母劉，側室徐及一子一女，聞變，皆自盡。

translations.literal: His father Ruyuan, mother Liu, concubine Xu, and one son and one daughter, hearing of the uprising, all killed themselves.
translations.idiomatic: His father Ruyuan, mother Liu, concubine Xu, and one son and one daughter, hearing of the uprising, all killed themselves.

sentences.zh: 僕冒死覓主屍，亦被害。

translations.literal: A servant risked death to seek his master's corpse and was also killed.
translations.idiomatic: A servant risked death to seek his master's corpse and was also killed.

sentences.zh: 初贈尚寶卿，世蔭百戶。

translations.literal: Initially he was posthumously made Director of the Imperial Treasures and granted a hereditary hundred-household post.
translations.idiomatic: Initially he was posthumously made Director of the Imperial Treasures and granted a hereditary hundred-household post.

sentences.zh: 崇禎元年，子暄援振德例，叩閽請優恤，贈光祿卿，世蔭錦衣千戶，建祠奉禮。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongzhen his son Xuan cited Zhende's precedent, knocked at the palace gate to request enhanced compensation, and Gaoxuan was posthumously made Director of the Imperial Household, granted a hereditary thousand-household post in the Embroidered Uniform Guard, and a shrine was built for ritual offerings.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Chongzhen his son Xuan cited Zhende's precedent, knocked at the palace gate to request enhanced compensation, and Gaoxuan was posthumously made Director of the Imperial Household, granted a hereditary thousand-household post in the Embroidered Uniform Guard, and a shrine was built for ritual offerings.

sentences.zh: 汝元等亦獲旌。

translations.literal: Ruyuan and the others also received commendation.
translations.idiomatic: Ruyuan and the others also received commendation.

sentences.zh: 十五年復以謚請，賜謚恭節。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year a posthumous title was again requested and the title Gongjie was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year a posthumous title was again requested and the title Gongjie was granted.

sentences.zh: 左重、王碩輔、洪維翰、黃啟鳴、趙愷、馮鳳雛、蘇樸、袁一修、張志譽、宋應臯

translations.literal: Zuo Chong, Wang Shuofu, Hong Weihan, Huang Qiming, Zhao Kai, Feng Fengchu, Su Pu, Yuan Yixiu, Zhang Zhiyu, Song Yinggao
translations.idiomatic: Zuo Chong, Wang Shuofu, Hong Weihan, Huang Qiming, Zhao Kai, Feng Fengchu, Su Pu, Yuan Yixiu, Zhang Zhiyu, Song Yinggao

sentences.zh: 時先後殉難者，灌縣知縣左重，率壯士追賊成都，力戰馬蹶，罵賊死。

translations.literal: At that time those who successively died for the cause included Guan County Magistrate Zuo Chong, who led stalwart men in pursuit of bandits to Chengdu, fought fiercely until his horse fell, cursed the bandits, and died.
translations.idiomatic: At that time those who successively died for the cause included Guan County Magistrate Zuo Chong, who led stalwart men in pursuit of bandits to Chengdu, fought fiercely until his horse fell, cursed the bandits, and died.

sentences.zh: 南溪知縣王碩輔，城陷自盡，賊支解之。

translations.literal: Nanxi Magistrate Wang Shuofu, when the city fell, killed himself; the bandits dismembered his body.
translations.idiomatic: Nanxi Magistrate Wang Shuofu, when the city fell, killed himself; the bandits dismembered his body.

sentences.zh: 桐梓知縣洪維翰，城陷，奪印，不屈死。

translations.literal: Tongzi Magistrate Hong Weihan, when the city fell, seized the seal and died without yielding.
translations.idiomatic: Tongzi Magistrate Hong Weihan, when the city fell, seized the seal and died without yielding.

sentences.zh: 典史黃啟鳴亦死。

translations.literal: Clerk Huang Qiming also died.
translations.idiomatic: Clerk Huang Qiming also died.

sentences.zh: 郫縣訓導趙愷，率眾擊賊，被刺死。

translations.literal: Pi County Instructor Zhao Kai led the people to strike the bandits and was stabbed to death.
translations.idiomatic: Pi County Instructor Zhao Kai led the people to strike the bandits and was stabbed to death.

sentences.zh: 遵義推官馮鳳雛，挺身禦賊，被創死。

translations.literal: Zunyi Reviewing Official Feng Fengchu stepped forward to resist the bandits and died of wounds.
translations.idiomatic: Zunyi Reviewing Official Feng Fengchu stepped forward to resist the bandits and died of wounds.

sentences.zh: 遵義司獄蘇樸、威遠經歷袁一修，義不汙賊，墜城死。

translations.literal: Zunyi Prison Warden Su Pu and Weiyuan Assistant Magistrate Yuan Yixiu, refusing to be defiled by bandits, fell from the wall and died.
translations.idiomatic: Zunyi Prison Warden Su Pu and Weiyuan Assistant Magistrate Yuan Yixiu, refusing to be defiled by bandits, fell from the wall and died.

sentences.zh: 大足主簿張志譽、典史宋應臯，集兵奮戰，力屈死。

translations.literal: Dazu Registrar Zhang Zhiyu and Clerk Song Yinggao gathered troops and fought fiercely; their strength gave out and they died.
translations.idiomatic: Dazu Registrar Zhang Zhiyu and Clerk Song Yinggao gathered troops and fought fiercely; their strength gave out and they died.

sentences.zh: 所司上其狀，贈重、碩輔、維翰尚寶卿，世蔭千戶。

translations.literal: The responsible offices reported their cases; Chong, Shuofu, and Weihan were posthumously made Directors of the Imperial Treasures and granted hereditary thousand-household posts.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible offices reported their cases; Chong, Shuofu, and Weihan were posthumously made Directors of the Imperial Treasures and granted hereditary thousand-household posts.

sentences.zh: 啟鳴重慶通判，愷重慶同知，俱世蔭試百戶。

translations.literal: Qiming was posthumously made Chongqing Assistant Prefect and Kai Chongqing Vice Commissioner; both were granted hereditary probationary hundred-household posts.
translations.idiomatic: Qiming was posthumously made Chongqing Assistant Prefect and Kai Chongqing Vice Commissioner; both were granted hereditary probationary hundred-household posts.

sentences.zh: 崇禎十二年，重子廷臯援高選例乞恩，命如其請。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Chongzhen Chong's son Tinggao cited Gaoxuan's precedent to beg favor; the order was granted as requested.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of Chongzhen Chong's son Tinggao cited Gaoxuan's precedent to beg favor; the order was granted as requested.

sentences.zh: 崇明父子據永寧，貴陽同知嘉興王昌胤分理永寧衛事，死難。

translations.literal: Chongming father and son held Yongning; Guiyang Vice Commissioner Wang Changyin of Jiaxing administered Yongning Guard affairs and died in the calamity.
translations.idiomatic: Chongming father and son held Yongning; Guiyang Vice Commissioner Wang Changyin of Jiaxing administered Yongning Guard affairs and died in the calamity.

sentences.zh: 贈僉事，賜祭。

translations.literal: He was posthumously made Assistant Commissioner and granted sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Assistant Commissioner and granted sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 崇禎初，其子監生世駿言：「賊踞永寧，臣父刺血草三揭，繳印上官，以次年五月再拜自縊。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Chongzhen his son, student of the Imperial Academy Shijun, said, "Bandits held Yongning; my father wrote three memorials in his own blood, surrendered his seal to his superior, and in the fifth month of the following year bowed twice and hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Chongzhen his son, student of the Imperial Academy Shijun, said, "Bandits held Yongning; my father wrote three memorials in his own blood, surrendered his seal to his superior, and in the fifth month of the following year bowed twice and hanged himself.

sentences.zh: 賊恨之，焚其屍。

translations.literal: The bandits hated him and burned his corpse.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits hated him and burned his corpse.

sentences.zh: 二孫、一孫女及僕婢十三人，同日被害。

translations.literal: Two grandsons, one granddaughter, and thirteen servants and maids were killed on the same day.
translations.idiomatic: Two grandsons, one granddaughter, and thirteen servants and maids were killed on the same day.

sentences.zh: 乞如張振德例，優加恤典。

translations.literal: I beg that, following Zhang Zhende's precedent, enhanced compensation be granted.
translations.idiomatic: I beg that, following Zhang Zhende's precedent, enhanced compensation be granted.

sentences.zh: 」報可。

translations.literal: " Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: " Approval was granted.

sentences.zh: 董盡倫

translations.literal: Dong Jinlun
translations.idiomatic: Dong Jinlun

sentences.zh: 董盡倫，字明吾，合州人。

translations.literal: Dong Jinlun, style name Mingwu, was a native of Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: Dong Jinlun, whose style was Mingwu, came from Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 萬曆中舉於鄉，除清水知縣，調安定，咸有惠政。

translations.literal: In the Wanli reign he passed the provincial examination, was appointed magistrate of Qingshui, transferred to Anding, and in both places had benevolent administration.
translations.idiomatic: During the Wanli reign he passed the provincial examination, was appointed magistrate of Qingshui, transferred to Anding, and in both places had benevolent administration.

sentences.zh: 秩滿，安定人詣闕奏留，詔加鞏昌同知，仍視縣事。

translations.literal: When his term ended, people of Anding went to the capital to petition for his retention; an edict added the title Gongchang Vice Commissioner while he still administered county affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When his term ended, people of Anding went to the capital to petition for his retention; an edict added the title Gongchang Vice Commissioner while he still administered county affairs.

sentences.zh: 久之，以同知理甘州軍餉，解職歸。

translations.literal: After a long time, as vice commissioner he managed Gansu military provisions, resigned, and returned home.
translations.idiomatic: After a long time, as vice commissioner he managed Gansu military provisions, resigned, and returned home.

sentences.zh: 天啟初，奢崇明反，率眾薄城。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianqi, She Chongming rebelled and led a host to press the city.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tianqi, She Chongming rebelled and led a host to press the city.

sentences.zh: 盡倫偕知州翁登彥固守。

translations.literal: Jinlun together with Prefect Weng Dengyan held firm in defense.
translations.idiomatic: Jinlun together with Prefect Weng Dengyan held firm in defense.

sentences.zh: 賊遣使說降，盡倫大怒，手刃賊使，抉其睛啖之，屢挫賊鋒，城獲全。

translations.literal: The bandits sent envoys to persuade surrender; Jinlun was greatly angered, killed the envoys with his own hand, gouged out their eyes and ate them, repeatedly blunted the bandit vanguard, and the city was preserved.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits sent envoys to persuade surrender; Jinlun flew into a rage, killed the envoys with his own hand, gouged out their eyes and ate them, repeatedly blunted the bandit advance, and the city was saved.

sentences.zh: 復率眾援銅梁有功，尋被檄搗重慶，孤軍深入，伏四起，遂虞死。

translations.literal: He again led troops to relieve Tongliang with merit; soon he was ordered by dispatch to strike at Chongqing, advanced deep with an isolated army, ambushes rose on every side, and he died in the calamity.
translations.idiomatic: He again led troops to relieve Tongliang with distinction; soon he was ordered to strike at Chongqing, advanced deep with an isolated army, ambushes rose on every side, and he was killed.

sentences.zh: 贈光祿少卿，世蔭百戶，建祠奉祀，尋改蔭指揮僉事。

translations.literal: He was posthumously made Vice Director of the Imperial Household, granted a hereditary hundred-household post, a shrine was built for sacrifice, and later the hereditary privilege was changed to battalion vice commander.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Vice Director of the Imperial Household, granted a hereditary hundred-household post, a shrine was built for him, and later the hereditary privilege was changed to battalion vice commander.

sentences.zh: 崇禎初，論全城功，改蔭錦衣千戶。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Chongzhen, in recognition of the merit of preserving the whole city, the hereditary privilege was changed to a thousand-household post in the Embroidered Uniform Guard.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Chongzhen, in recognition of saving the whole city, the hereditary privilege was changed to a thousand-household post in the Embroidered Uniform Guard.

sentences.zh: 李忠臣、高光、胡縝、聶繩昌、吳長齡、胡一夔

translations.literal: Li Zhongchen, Gao Guang, Hu Zhen, Nie Shengchang, Wu Changling, Hu Yikui
translations.idiomatic: Li Zhongchen, Gao Guang, Hu Zhen, Nie Shengchang, Wu Changling, Hu Yikui

sentences.zh: 其時里居士大夫死節者，有李忠臣，永寧人，官松潘參政。

translations.literal: At that time among local gentry and officials who died maintaining integrity was Li Zhongchen, a native of Yongning, who had served as Songpan Vice Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: At that time among local gentry and officials who died maintaining their integrity was Li Zhongchen of Yongning, who had served as Songpan Vice Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 家居，陷賊。

translations.literal: Living at home, he fell into bandit hands.
translations.idiomatic: Living at home, he fell into bandit hands.

sentences.zh: 募死士，密約總兵官楊愈懋，令以大兵薄城，己為內應。

translations.literal: He recruited men willing to die, secretly arranged with Regional Commander Yang Yuma to have a large force press the city, and himself would serve as inner collaborator.
translations.idiomatic: He recruited men willing to die, secretly arranged with Regional Commander Yang Yuma to have a large force press the city, and himself would serve as inner collaborator.

sentences.zh: 事泄，合門遇害。

translations.literal: The plan leaked and the whole household was killed.
translations.idiomatic: The plan leaked and the whole household was killed.

sentences.zh: 高光，瀘州人，嘗為應天通判。

translations.literal: Gao Guang, a native of Luzhou, had once served as Yingtian Assistant Prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Guang of Luzhou had once served as Yingtian Assistant Prefect.

sentences.zh: 城陷，發為僧，與子在昆募壯士，殺賊百餘。

translations.literal: When the city fell he tonsured himself as a monk; with his son Zikun he recruited stalwart men and killed more than one hundred bandits.
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell he tonsured himself as a monk; with his son Zikun he recruited stalwart men and killed more than one hundred bandits.

sentences.zh: 賊怒，追至大葉坎，光罵賊不屈，與家眾十二人同死。

translations.literal: The bandits in anger pursued to Dayekan; Guang cursed the bandits and would not yield; he died together with twelve members of his household.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits in anger pursued to Dayekan; Guang cursed them and would not yield; he died together with twelve members of his household.

sentences.zh: 胡縝，永寧舉人。

translations.literal: Hu Zhen was a provincial graduate of Yongning.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Zhen was a provincial graduate of Yongning.

sentences.zh: 預策崇明必反，上書當事，不納。

translations.literal: He foresaw that Chongming would surely rebel, wrote to the authorities, and was not heeded.
translations.idiomatic: He foresaw that Chongming would surely rebel, wrote to the authorities, and was not heeded.

sentences.zh: 賊起，被執，嚴刑錮獄中。

translations.literal: When the bandits rose he was captured and imprisoned under severe punishment.
translations.idiomatic: When the bandits rose he was captured and imprisoned under severe punishment.

sentences.zh: 弟緯傾家救免，乃糾義徒，潛結賊將張令等，執其偽相。

translations.literal: His younger brother Wei spent the family fortune to save him; he then rallied righteous followers, secretly joined with bandit generals such as Zhang Ling, and seized their false chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Wei spent the family fortune to save him; he then rallied righteous followers, secretly joined with bandit generals such as Zhang Ling, and seized their false chancellor.

sentences.zh: 部勒行陣，自當一面，數斬馘，賊甚畏之。

translations.literal: He organized battle formations, held one front himself, repeatedly took heads, and the bandits greatly feared him.
translations.idiomatic: He organized battle formations, held one front himself, repeatedly took heads, and the bandits greatly feared him.

sentences.zh: 既而為火藥焚死。

translations.literal: Later he was burned to death by gunpowder.
translations.idiomatic: Later he was burned to death by gunpowder.

sentences.zh: 聶繩昌，富順舉人。

translations.literal: Nie Shengchang was a provincial graduate of Fushun.
translations.idiomatic: Nie Shengchang was a provincial graduate of Fushun.

sentences.zh: 毀家募義勇禦賊，戰死。

translations.literal: He ruined his family to recruit righteous volunteers to resist bandits and died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: He ruined his family to recruit righteous volunteers to resist bandits and died in battle.

sentences.zh: 吳長齡，瀘州監生。

translations.literal: Wu Changling was a Luzhou student of the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Changling was a Luzhou student of the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 率眾恢復瀘州，尋中伏，父子俱戰死。

translations.literal: He led the people to recover Luzhou; soon he fell into an ambush and father and son both died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: He led the people to recover Luzhou; soon he fell into an ambush and father and son both died in battle.

sentences.zh: 胡一夔，興文人。

translations.literal: Hu Yikui was a native of Xingwen.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Yikui came from Xingwen.

sentences.zh: 仕龍陽縣丞，被執，不屈死。

translations.literal: He served as Longyang County Assistant Magistrate, was captured, and died without yielding.
translations.idiomatic: He served as Longyang County Assistant Magistrate, was captured, and died without yielding.

sentences.zh: 皆未予恤。

translations.literal: None were granted compensation.
translations.idiomatic: None were granted compensation.

sentences.zh: 龔萬祿 李世勛

translations.literal: Gong Wanlu, Li Shixun
translations.idiomatic: Gong Wanlu, Li Shixun

sentences.zh: 龔萬祿，貴州人。

translations.literal: Gong Wanlu was a native of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Gong Wanlu came from Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 目不知書，有膽志，膂力過人。

translations.literal: He could not read, but had courage and resolve and strength beyond ordinary men.
translations.idiomatic: He could not read, but had courage and resolve and strength beyond ordinary men.

sentences.zh: 從劉綎征楊應龍，先登海龍囤，署守備，戍建武所。
