translations.literal: He followed Liu Ting in the campaign against Yang Yinglong, was first to ascend Hailong Fort, was appointed garrison commander, and guarded Jianwu Post.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Liu Ting in the campaign against Yang Yinglong, was first to ascend Hailong Fort, was appointed garrison commander, and guarded Jianwu Post.

sentences.zh: 奢崇明反，眾推萬祿遊擊將軍，主兵事。

translations.literal: When She Chongming rebelled, the people pushed Wanlu as mobile corps general to command military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When She Chongming rebelled, the people pushed Wanlu as mobile corps general to command military affairs.

sentences.zh: 指揮李世勛，名位先萬祿，亦受節制，戮力固守。

translations.literal: Commander Li Shixun, whose rank preceded Wanlu's, also accepted his command and strove together to hold firm.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Li Shixun, whose rank preceded Wanlu's, also accepted his command and strove together to hold firm.

sentences.zh: 崇明謀犯成都，憚萬祿牽其後，遣部將張令說降。

translations.literal: Chongming planned to attack Chengdu but feared Wanlu holding his rear; he sent subordinate general Zhang Ling to persuade surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Chongming planned to attack Chengdu but feared Wanlu holding his rear; he sent subordinate general Zhang Ling to persuade surrender.

sentences.zh: 令與萬祿結，紿崇明以降。

translations.literal: Ling joined with Wanlu and deceived Chongming into believing they would surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Ling joined with Wanlu and deceived Chongming into believing they would surrender.

sentences.zh: 崇明果遣他將來戍，萬祿脅降之，誘殺無算。

translations.literal: Chongming indeed sent another general to garrison; Wanlu coerced his surrender and lured countless men to their deaths.
translations.idiomatic: Chongming indeed sent another general to garrison; Wanlu coerced his surrender and lured countless men to their deaths.

sentences.zh: 復微服走敘州，說副使徐如珂曰：「賊精騎萃成都，留故巢者悉老弱，誠假萬祿萬人搗其巢，彼必還救，成都圍立解矣。

translations.literal: He again went in disguise to Xuzhou and said to Vice Commissioner Xu Ruke, "The bandits' elite cavalry are gathered at Chengdu; those left in the old nest are all old and weak; if ten thousand men under Wanlu were lent to strike their nest, they would surely return to the rescue and the siege of Chengdu would be immediately lifted.
translations.idiomatic: He again went in disguise to Xuzhou and said to Vice Commissioner Xu Ruke, "The bandits' elite cavalry are gathered at Chengdu; those left in the old nest are all old and weak; if ten thousand men under Wanlu were lent to strike their nest, they would surely return to the rescue and the siege of Chengdu would be immediately lifted.

sentences.zh: 」如珂奇其計，而不能用。

translations.literal: " Ruke marveled at the plan but could not use it.
translations.idiomatic: " Ruke marveled at the plan but could not use it.

sentences.zh: 未幾，賊悉眾攻建武，萬祿邀擊十里外，兵少敗還，城遂陷。

translations.literal: Before long the bandits attacked Jianwu with all their forces; Wanlu intercepted them ten li out, his troops were few and he was defeated and retreated, and the city then fell.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the bandits attacked Jianwu with all their forces; Wanlu intercepted them ten li out, his troops were too few and he was defeated and retreated, and the city then fell.

sentences.zh: 世勛具衣冠再拜，率家屬自焚死。

translations.literal: Shixun dressed in full regalia and bowed twice, led his family to set themselves afire, and died.
translations.idiomatic: Shixun dressed in full regalia and bowed twice, led his family to set themselves afire, and died.

sentences.zh: 萬祿手刃兩妾、兩孫，自刎不殊，乃握槊馳出，大呼：「我龔萬祿也，孰能追我者！

translations.literal: Wanlu killed two concubines and two grandsons with his own hand, cut his own throat without finishing the deed, then grasped a spear and charged out, shouting, "I am Gong Wanlu—who can pursue me!
translations.idiomatic: Wanlu killed two concubines and two grandsons with his own hand, cut his own throat without finishing the deed, then grasped a spear and charged out, shouting, "I am Gong Wanlu—who can pursue me!

sentences.zh: 」賊相視不敢逼。

translations.literal: " The bandits looked at one another and did not dare press close.
translations.idiomatic: " The bandits looked at one another and did not dare press close.

sentences.zh: 走至敘州，乞師巡撫朱燮元，遂以兵復建武。

translations.literal: He fled to Xuzhou, begged Grand Coordinator Zhu Xieyuan for troops, and then with soldiers recovered Jianwu.
translations.idiomatic: He fled to Xuzhou, begged Grand Coordinator Zhu Xieyuan for troops, and then with soldiers recovered Jianwu.

sentences.zh: 會官軍敗於江門，賊四面來攻，萬祿力戰三日，手刃數十人，與子崇學並死。

translations.literal: When the government army was defeated at Jiangmen, bandits attacked from all sides; Wanlu fought fiercely for three days, killed several dozen men with his own hand, and died together with his son Chongxue.
translations.idiomatic: When the government army was defeated at Jiangmen, bandits attacked from all sides; Wanlu fought fiercely for three days, killed several dozen men with his own hand, and died together with his son Chongxue.

sentences.zh: 詔贈都督僉事，立祠賜祭，世蔭百戶。

translations.literal: An edict posthumously made him Vice Commander-in-Chief, ordered a shrine built and sacrifice granted, and granted a hereditary hundred-household post.
translations.idiomatic: An edict posthumously made him Vice Commander-in-Chief, ordered a shrine built and sacrifice granted, and granted a hereditary hundred-household post.

sentences.zh: 翟英、韓應泰、郁聯若、張羽

translations.literal: Zhai Ying, Han Yingtai, Yu Lianruo, Zhang Yu
translations.idiomatic: Zhai Ying, Han Yingtai, Yu Lianruo, Zhang Yu

sentences.zh: 時成都衛指揮翟英扼賊龍泉驛，成都後衛指揮韓應泰赴援成都，遇賊草堂寺，小河所鎮撫郁聯若鏖賊城西，茂州百戶張羽救援郫縣，皆力戰死。

translations.literal: At that time Chengdu Guard Commander Zhai Ying blocked bandits at Longquan Post; Chengdu Rear Guard Commander Han Yingtai went to relieve Chengdu and met bandits at Caotang Temple; Xiaohe Post Assistant Commander Yu Lianruo fought bandits fiercely west of the city; Maozhou Hundred-Household Commander Zhang Yu went to relieve Pixian—all died fighting.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Chengdu Guard Commander Zhai Ying blocked bandits at Longquan Post; Chengdu Rear Guard Commander Han Yingtai went to relieve Chengdu and met bandits at Caotang Temple; Xiaohe Post Assistant Commander Yu Lianruo fought bandits fiercely west of the city; Maozhou Hundred-Household Commander Zhang Yu went to relieve Pixian—all died fighting.

sentences.zh: 管良相

translations.literal: Guan Liangxiang
translations.idiomatic: Guan Liangxiang

sentences.zh: 管良相者，烏撒衛指揮也，為人慷慨負奇節。

translations.literal: Guan Liangxiang was commander of Wusa Guard; as a man he was generous and possessed extraordinary integrity.
translations.idiomatic: Guan Liangxiang was commander of Wusa Guard; as a man he was generous and possessed extraordinary integrity.

sentences.zh: 天啟初，樊龍等反於四川，巡撫李枟召至麾下，與籌軍事。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianqi, Fan Long and others rebelled in Sichuan; Grand Coordinator Li Zong summoned him to his staff to plan military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tianqi, Fan Long and others rebelled in Sichuan; Grand Coordinator Li Zong summoned him to his staff to plan military affairs.

sentences.zh: 良相策安邦彥必反，佐枟為固守計。

translations.literal: Liangxiang foresaw that An Bangyan would surely rebel and assisted Zong in plans for firm defense.
translations.idiomatic: Liangxiang foresaw that An Bangyan would surely rebel and assisted Zong in plans for firm defense.

sentences.zh: 尋以祖母疾，乞假婦，泣語枟曰：「烏撒孤城，密邇水西，且與安效良相仇。

translations.literal: Soon, because of his grandmother's illness, he begged leave to return to his wife and wept, saying to Zong, "Wusa is an isolated city close to Shuixi and moreover at odds with An Bangyan.
translations.idiomatic: Soon, because of his grandmother's illness, he begged leave to return to his wife and wept, saying to Zong, "Wusa is an isolated city close to Shuixi and moreover at odds with An Bangyan.

sentences.zh: 水西有變，禍必首及，良相無子，願以死報國。

translations.literal: If Shuixi has trouble, disaster will surely strike here first; Liangxiang has no son and wishes to repay the state with his death.
translations.idiomatic: If Shuixi has trouble, disaster will surely strike here first; Liangxiang has no son and wishes to repay the state with his death.

sentences.zh: 乞建長策，保此一方。

translations.literal: I beg you to devise a long-term plan to protect this region.
translations.idiomatic: I beg you to devise a long-term plan to protect this region.

sentences.zh: 」逾月，邦彥果反，圍其城，良相固守不下。

translations.literal: " More than a month later Bangyan indeed rebelled, besieged the city, and Liangxiang held firm and would not yield.
translations.idiomatic: " More than a month later Bangyan indeed rebelled, besieged the city, and Liangxiang held firm and would not yield.

sentences.zh: 久之，外援不至，城陷，自縊死。

translations.literal: After a long time external relief did not arrive; the city fell and he hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: After a long time external relief did not arrive; the city fell and he hanged himself.

sentences.zh: 李應期、朱運泰、蔣邦俊、王明重、丘述堯、金紹勛、簡登、劉臯、臯子景、劉三畏

translations.literal: Li Yingqi, Zhu Yuntai, Jiang Bangjun, Wang Mingzhong, Qiu Shuyao, Jin Shaoxun, Jian Deng, Liu Gao, Gao's son Jing, Liu Sanwei
translations.idiomatic: Li Yingqi, Zhu Yuntai, Jiang Bangjun, Wang Mingzhong, Qiu Shuyao, Jin Shaoxun, Jian Deng, Liu Gao, Gao's son Jing, Liu Sanwei

sentences.zh: 同官李應期、朱運泰、蔣邦俊亦遇害。

translations.literal: Fellow officials Li Yingqi, Zhu Yuntai, and Jiang Bangjun were also killed.
translations.idiomatic: Fellow officials Li Yingqi, Zhu Yuntai, and Jiang Bangjun were also killed.

sentences.zh: 時普定衛王明重、威清衛丘述堯、平壩衛金紹勛、坎陽把總簡登、龍里故守備劉臯、臯子景並死難，而訓導劉三畏，賊至不避，兀坐齋中，見殺，人稱「龍里三劉」。

translations.literal: At that time Puding Guard Wang Mingzhong, Weiqing Guard Qiu Shuyao, Pingba Guard Jin Shaoxun, Kanyang Battalion Commander Jian Deng, former Longli Garrison Commander Liu Gao, and Gao's son Jing all died in the calamity; Instructor Liu Sanwei, when bandits arrived, did not flee but sat upright in his study and was killed—people called them "the three Lius of Longli."
translations.idiomatic: At that time Puding Guard Wang Mingzhong, Weiqing Guard Qiu Shuyao, Pingba Guard Jin Shaoxun, Kanyang Battalion Commander Jian Deng, former Longli Garrison Commander Liu Gao, and Gao's son Jing all died in the calamity; Instructor Liu Sanwei, when bandits arrived, did not flee but sat upright in his study and was killed—people called them "the three Lius of Longli."

sentences.zh: 徐朝綱

translations.literal: Xu Chaogang
translations.idiomatic: Xu Chaogang

sentences.zh: 五年正月恤殉難諸臣，贈朝綱光祿少卿，蔭子入國學。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifth year compensation was granted to officials who died for the cause; Chaogang was posthumously made Vice Director of the Imperial Household and a son was granted enrollment in the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fifth year compensation was granted to officials who died for the cause; Chaogang was posthumously made Vice Director of the Imperial Household and a son was enrolled in the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 子天鳳甫第進士，即奔喪歸，服闋，授戶部主事。

translations.literal: His son Tianfeng had just passed the jinshi examination; he immediately returned for mourning; when the mourning period ended he was appointed secretary in the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: His son Tianfeng had just passed the jinshi examination; he immediately returned for mourning; when the mourning period ended he was appointed secretary in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「臣家一門，臣死忠，妻死節，婦死姑，孫死祖，婢僕死主。

translations.literal: In a memorial he said, "In my household: the subject died in loyalty, the wife died in chastity, the daughter-in-law died for her mother-in-law, the grandson died for his grandfather, and servants died for their master.
translations.idiomatic: In a memorial he said, "In my household: the subject died in loyalty, the wife died in chastity, the daughter-in-law died for her mother-in-law, the grandson died for his grandfather, and servants died for their master.

sentences.zh: 此從來未有之節烈，乞如張振德例，再加優恤。

translations.literal: Such integrity and martyrdom have never been seen before; I beg that, following Zhang Zhende's precedent, enhanced compensation be granted.
translations.idiomatic: Such integrity and martyrdom have never been seen before; I beg that, following Zhang Zhende's precedent, enhanced compensation be granted.

sentences.zh: 臣母、臣嫂，一體旌表。

translations.literal: My mother and my sister-in-law should both receive commendation.
translations.idiomatic: My mother and my sister-in-law should both receive commendation.

sentences.zh: 」帝深嘉之，再贈光祿卿，改蔭錦衣世千戶，賜祭葬，立祠建坊，諸從死者皆附祀。

translations.literal: " The emperor deeply praised this; Chaogang was again posthumously made Director of the Imperial Household, the hereditary privilege was changed to a thousand-household post in the Embroidered Uniform Guard, sacrificial burial was granted, a shrine and memorial arch were built, and all who died with him were given joint sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor deeply praised this; Chaogang was again posthumously made Director of the Imperial Household, the hereditary privilege was changed to a thousand-household post in the Embroidered Uniform Guard, sacrificial burial was granted, a shrine and memorial arch were built, and all who died with him were given joint sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 同時殉難者：

translations.literal: Those who died for the cause at the same time:
translations.idiomatic: Those who died for the cause at the same time:

sentences.zh: 楊以成

translations.literal: Yang Yicheng
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yicheng

sentences.zh: 楊以成，雲南路南人。

translations.literal: Yang Yicheng was a native of Lunan in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yicheng came from Lunan in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 萬曆中，由貢生授貴陽通判，理畢節衛事。

translations.literal: In the Wanli reign, from tribute student he was appointed Guiyang Assistant Prefect and administered Bijie Guard affairs.
translations.idiomatic: During the Wanli reign, from tribute student he was appointed Guiyang Assistant Prefect and administered Bijie Guard affairs.

sentences.zh: 秩滿，進同知，仍治畢節。

translations.literal: When his term ended he was promoted to vice commissioner and still administered Bijie.
translations.idiomatic: When his term ended he was promoted to vice commissioner and still administered Bijie.

sentences.zh: 邦彥圍貴陽，以成具蠟書乞援於雲南巡撫沈儆炌。

translations.literal: When Bangyan besieged Guiyang, Yicheng prepared a wax-sealed letter begging relief from Yunnan Grand Coordinator Shen Jingcan.
translations.idiomatic: When Bangyan besieged Guiyang, Yicheng prepared a wax-sealed letter begging relief from Yunnan Grand Coordinator Shen Jingcan.

sentences.zh: 書發而賊已至，戰卻之。

translations.literal: The letter was sent but the bandits had already arrived; he fought and drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: The letter was sent but the bandits had already arrived; he fought and drove them back.

sentences.zh: 賊來益眾，以成遣吏懷印間道趨省，身督吏民拒守。

translations.literal: The bandits came in greater numbers; Yicheng sent a clerk bearing the seal by a secret route to the provincial capital while he personally directed officials and people in defense.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits came in greater numbers; Yicheng sent a clerk bearing the seal by a secret route to the provincial capital while he personally directed officials and people in defense.

sentences.zh: 會援兵至，賊方夜逃，而衛吏阮世爵為內應，城遂陷。

translations.literal: When relief troops arrived the bandits were just fleeing by night, but Guard Clerk Ruan Shijue served as inner collaborator and the city then fell.
translations.idiomatic: When relief troops arrived the bandits were just fleeing by night, but Guard Clerk Ruan Shijue served as inner collaborator and the city then fell.

sentences.zh: 以成倉皇投繯，賊繫之去。

translations.literal: Yicheng in haste tried to hang himself; the bandits bound him and took him away.
translations.idiomatic: Yicheng in haste tried to hang himself; the bandits bound him and took him away.

sentences.zh: 乃為書述賊中情形，置竹筒中，遣弟以恭赴雲南告變，至散納溪，賊搜得其書，並以成殺之，家屬死者十三人。

translations.literal: He then wrote a letter describing conditions among the bandits, placed it in a bamboo tube, and sent his younger brother Yigong to Yunnan to report the uprising; at Sannaxi the bandits searched and found the letter and also killed Yicheng; thirteen members of his family died.
translations.idiomatic: He then wrote a letter describing conditions among the bandits, placed it in a bamboo tube, and sent his younger brother Yigong to Yunnan to report the uprising; at Sannaxi the bandits searched and found the letter and also killed Yicheng; thirteen members of his family died.

sentences.zh: 贈按察僉事，賜葬。

translations.literal: He was posthumously made Surveillance Vice Commissioner and granted burial.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Surveillance Vice Commissioner and granted burial.

sentences.zh: 鄭鼎，字爾調，龍溪人。

translations.literal: Zheng Ding, style name Ertiao, was a native of Longxi.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Ding, whose style was Ertiao, came from Longxi.

sentences.zh: 由鄉舉為廣順知州。

translations.literal: From provincial examination he became Prefect of Guangshun.
translations.idiomatic: From provincial examination he became Prefect of Guangshun.

sentences.zh: 策安邦彥必反，上書當事言狀。

translations.literal: He foresaw that An Bangyan would surely rebel and wrote to the authorities describing the situation.
translations.idiomatic: He foresaw that An Bangyan would surely rebel and wrote to the authorities describing the situation.

sentences.zh: 州故無城，督民樹柵實以士。

translations.literal: The prefecture originally had no wall; he directed the people to erect palisades filled with earth.
translations.idiomatic: The prefecture originally had no wall; he directed the people to erect palisades filled with earth.

sentences.zh: 無何，邦彥果反，來攻城，鼎誓死固守。

translations.literal: Before long Bangyan indeed rebelled, came to attack the city, and Ding swore to die holding firm.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Bangyan indeed rebelled, came to attack the city, and Ding swore to die holding firm.

sentences.zh: 或言賊勢盛，宜走定番。

translations.literal: Some said the bandit force was strong and he should flee to Dingfan.
translations.idiomatic: Some said the bandit force was strong and he should flee to Dingfan.

sentences.zh: 鼎曰：「吾守土吏也，義當與城存亡。

translations.literal: Ding said, "I am an official who guards the land; by duty I should live or die with the city.
translations.idiomatic: Ding said, "I am an official who guards the land; by duty I should live or die with the city.

sentences.zh: 」及賊入，與士官金燦端坐堂上，並為賊所殺，婢僕從死者六人。

translations.literal: " When the bandits entered, he and native official Jin Can sat upright in the hall and were both killed by bandits; six maids and servants died with them.
translations.idiomatic: " When the bandits entered, he and native official Jin Can sat upright in the hall and were both killed by bandits; six maids and servants died with them.

sentences.zh: 吏目胡士統被執，亦不屈死。

translations.literal: Clerk Hu Shitong was captured and also died without yielding.
translations.idiomatic: Clerk Hu Shitong was captured and also died without yielding.

sentences.zh: 巡撫李枟上於朝，贈僉事，賜祭。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator Li Zong reported to the court; Ding was posthumously made Assistant Commissioner and granted sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Li Zong reported to the court; Ding was posthumously made Assistant Commissioner and granted sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 崇禎元年，以成子舉人興南，鼎子舉人昆禎皆援朝綱例，請加恤，並贈光祿卿，世蔭錦衣千戶，予祭葬，有司建祠立坊，以恭亦附祀。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongzhen, Yicheng's son provincial graduate Xingnan and Ding's son provincial graduate Kunzhen both cited Chaogang's precedent to request enhanced compensation; both were posthumously made Directors of the Imperial Household, granted hereditary thousand-household posts in the Embroidered Uniform Guard, given sacrificial burial, and the local authorities built shrines and memorial arches; Yigong was also given joint sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Chongzhen, Yicheng's son provincial graduate Xingnan and Ding's son provincial graduate Kunzhen both cited Chaogang's precedent to request enhanced compensation; both were posthumously made Directors of the Imperial Household, granted hereditary thousand-household posts in the Embroidered Uniform Guard, given sacrificial burial, and the local authorities built shrines and memorial arches; Yigong was also given joint sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 昆禎後舉進士，歷御史，尚寶卿。

translations.literal: Kunzhen later passed the jinshi examination, served as censor, and became Director of the Imperial Treasures.
translations.idiomatic: Kunzhen later passed the jinshi examination, served as censor, and became Director of the Imperial Treasures.

sentences.zh: 孫克恕

translations.literal: Sun Keshu
translations.idiomatic: Sun Keshu

sentences.zh: 時有孫克恕者，字推之，馬平人。

translations.literal: At that time there was Sun Keshu, style name Tuizhi, a native of Maping.
translations.idiomatic: At that time there was Sun Keshu, whose style was Tuizhi, from Maping.

sentences.zh: 舉於鄉，歷官貴州副使，分巡思石道。

translations.literal: He passed the provincial examination, rose to Guizhou Vice Commissioner, and patrolled the Sishi Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the provincial examination, rose to Guizhou Vice Commissioner, and patrolled the Sishi Circuit.

sentences.zh: 禦賊戰死，有虎守其骸不去，蠻人嗟異。

translations.literal: He resisted bandits and died in battle; a tiger guarded his corpse and would not leave; the barbarians marveled.
translations.idiomatic: He resisted bandits and died in battle; a tiger guarded his corpse and would not leave; the barbarians marveled.

sentences.zh: 事聞，贈太僕卿，賜祭葬。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, he was posthumously made Director of the Imperial Stud and granted sacrificial burial.
translations.idiomatic: When the matter was reported, he was posthumously made Director of the Imperial Stud and granted sacrificial burial.

sentences.zh: 姬文胤

translations.literal: Ji Wenyin
translations.idiomatic: Ji Wenyin

sentences.zh: 姬文胤，字士昌，華州人。

translations.literal: Ji Wenyin, style name Shichang, was a native of Huazhou.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Wenyin, whose style was Shichang, came from Huazhou.

sentences.zh: 舉於鄉。

translations.literal: He passed the provincial examination.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the provincial examination.

sentences.zh: 天啟二年授滕縣知縣。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tianqi he was appointed magistrate of Teng County.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Tianqi he was appointed magistrate of Teng County.

sentences.zh: 視事甫三日，白蓮賊徐鴻儒薄城，民什九從亂。

translations.literal: He had administered affairs barely three days when White Lotus bandit Xu Hongru pressed the city and nine-tenths of the people joined the rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: He had administered affairs barely three days when White Lotus bandit Xu Hongru pressed the city and nine-tenths of the people joined the rebellion.

sentences.zh: 文胤徒步叫號，驅吏卒登陴，不滿三百，望賊輒走，存者才數十。

translations.literal: Wenyin on foot shouted and called, drove clerks and soldiers onto the battlements—fewer than three hundred; at sight of bandits they fled, and only several dozen remained.
translations.idiomatic: Wenyin on foot shouted and called, drove clerks and soldiers onto the battlements—fewer than three hundred; at sight of bandits they fled, and only several dozen remained.

sentences.zh: 問何故從賊，曰：「禍由董二。

translations.literal: He asked why they followed the bandits; they said, "The disaster is because of Dong the Second.
translations.idiomatic: He asked why they followed the bandits; they said, "The disaster is because of Dong the Second.

sentences.zh: 」董二者，故延綏巡撫董國光子也，居鄉貪暴，民不聊生，故從賊。

translations.literal: " Dong the Second was the son of former Yan-sui Grand Coordinator Dong Guoguang; living in the countryside he was greedy and violent, the people could not make a living, and therefore they followed the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: " Dong the Second was the son of former Yan-sui Grand Coordinator Dong Guoguang; living in the countryside he was greedy and violent, the people could not make a living, and therefore they followed the bandits.

sentences.zh: 文胤憑城諭曰：「良民以董二故，挺而從賊。

translations.literal: Wenyin leaned on the wall and announced, "Good people took up arms and followed the bandits because of Dong the Second.
translations.idiomatic: Wenyin leaned on the wall and announced, "Good people took up arms and followed the bandits because of Dong the Second.

sentences.zh: 吾將執二置諸法，為若雪憤，可乎？

translations.literal: I will seize the Second and put him to the law to vent your anger—is that acceptable?
translations.idiomatic: I will seize the Second and put him to the law to vent your anger—is that acceptable?

sentences.zh: 」文胤身長赤面，須髯戟張，賊望見，駭為神人，皆歡呼羅拜。

translations.literal: " Wenyin was tall with a red face and bristling beard; when the bandits saw him they were awestruck as at a divine being and all shouted and bowed in a circle.
translations.idiomatic: " Wenyin was tall with a red face and bristling beard; when the bandits saw him they were awestruck as at a divine being and all shouted and bowed in a circle.

sentences.zh: 俄而發箭西隅，斃二賊。

translations.literal: Soon arrows were loosed from the west corner and two bandits were killed.
translations.idiomatic: Soon arrows were loosed from the west corner and two bandits were killed.

sentences.zh: 視之，延綏沙柳竿也。

translations.literal: Looking, it was Sha Liugan of Yan-sui.
translations.idiomatic: Looking, it was Sha Liugan of Yan-sui.

sentences.zh: 賊謂文胤紿之，大憤，肉薄登城，眾悉潰。

translations.literal: The bandits thought Wenyin had deceived them, were greatly enraged, pressed close to scale the wall, and the whole force broke.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits thought Wenyin had deceived them, were greatly enraged, pressed close to scale the wall, and the whole force broke.

sentences.zh: 文胤緋衣坐堂皇，嚼齒罵賊。

translations.literal: Wenyin in crimson robes sat in the main hall, grinding his teeth and cursing the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Wenyin in crimson robes sat in the main hall, grinding his teeth and cursing the bandits.

sentences.zh: 賊前，搏裂冠裳，械系之，罵不屈。

translations.literal: The bandits came forward, tore his cap and robes, bound him in shackles, and he cursed without yielding.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits came forward, tore his cap and robes, bound him in shackles, and he cursed without yielding.

sentences.zh: 三日潛解印，畀小吏魏顯照及家僮李守務，北向拜闕，遂自經。

translations.literal: On the third day he secretly removed the seal and gave it to clerk Wei Xianzhao and household servant Li Shouwu, bowed toward the north to the imperial court, and then hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: On the third day he secretly removed the seal and gave it to clerk Wei Xianzhao and household servant Li Shouwu, bowed toward the north to the imperial court, and then hanged himself.

sentences.zh: 賊搒掠顯照索印，顯照潛授其父，而與守務罵賊，並死之。

translations.literal: The bandits beat and plundered Xianzhao to demand the seal; Xianzhao secretly gave it to his father, then together with Shouwu cursed the bandits and both died.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits beat and plundered Xianzhao to demand the seal; Xianzhao secretly gave it to his father, then together with Shouwu cursed the bandits and both died.

sentences.zh: 事聞，贈太僕少卿，立祠致祀，錄一子，優恤顯照、守務家。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, he was posthumously made Vice Director of the Imperial Stud, a shrine was built for sacrifice, one son was granted office, and the families of Xianzhao and Shouwu were richly compensated.
translations.idiomatic: When the matter was reported, he was posthumously made Vice Director of the Imperial Stud, a shrine was built for sacrifice, one son was granted office, and the families of Xianzhao and Shouwu were richly compensated.

sentences.zh: 董二逾城遁去。

translations.literal: Dong the Second fled over the wall and escaped.
translations.idiomatic: Dong the Second fled over the wall and escaped.

sentences.zh: 孟承光

translations.literal: Meng Chengguang
translations.idiomatic: Meng Chengguang

sentences.zh: 時賊陷鄒縣，博士孟承光被執，詬詈不屈死。

translations.literal: At that time when bandits took Zou County, Erudite Meng Chengguang was captured, reviled them, and died without yielding.
translations.idiomatic: At that time when bandits took Zou County, Erudite Meng Chengguang was captured, reviled them, and died without yielding.

sentences.zh: 贈尚寶少卿，世蔭錦衣千戶。

translations.literal: He was posthumously made Vice Director of the Imperial Treasures and granted a hereditary thousand-household post in the Embroidered Uniform Guard.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Vice Director of the Imperial Treasures and granted a hereditary thousand-household post in the Embroidered Uniform Guard.

sentences.zh: 承光，字永觀，亞聖裔，世蔭《五經》博士也。

translations.literal: Chengguang, style name Yongguan, was a descendant of the Second Sage and held the hereditary post of Erudite of the Five Classics.
translations.idiomatic: Chengguang, whose style was Yongguan, was a descendant of the Second Sage and held the hereditary post of Erudite of the Five Classics.

sentences.zh: 朱萬年

translations.literal: Zhu Wannian
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Wannian

sentences.zh: 朱萬年，黎平人。

translations.literal: Zhu Wannian was a native of Liping.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Wannian came from Liping.

sentences.zh: 萬曆中，舉於鄉。

translations.literal: In the Wanli reign he passed the provincial examination.
translations.idiomatic: During the Wanli reign he passed the provincial examination.

sentences.zh: 歷萊州知府，有惠政。

translations.literal: He served as Prefect of Laizhou and had benevolent administration.
translations.idiomatic: He served as Prefect of Laizhou and had benevolent administration.

sentences.zh: 崇禎五年，叛將李九成等陷登州，率眾來犯。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Chongzhen, rebel generals Li Jiucheng and others took Dengzhou and led a host to attack.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Chongzhen, rebel generals Li Jiucheng and others took Dengzhou and led a host to attack.

sentences.zh: 萬年率吏民固守。

translations.literal: Wannian led officials and people to hold firm.
translations.idiomatic: Wannian led officials and people to hold firm.

sentences.zh: 時山東巡撫徐從治、登萊巡撫謝璉並在城中，被圍，堅守數月，從治中炮死。

translations.literal: At that time Shandong Grand Coordinator Xu Congzhi and Deng-Lai Grand Coordinator Xie Lian were both in the city; besieged, they held firm for several months; Congzhi was killed by cannon fire.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Shandong Grand Coordinator Xu Congzhi and Deng-Lai Grand Coordinator Xie Lian were both in the city; besieged, they held firm for several months; Congzhi was killed by cannon fire.

sentences.zh: 賊詭乞降，璉率萬年往受，為所執。

translations.literal: The bandits falsely begged to surrender; Lian led Wannian to accept and they were seized.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits falsely begged to surrender; Lian led Wannian to accept and they were seized.

sentences.zh: 萬年曰：「爾執我無益，盍以精騎從我，呼守者出降。

translations.literal: Wannian said, "Seizing me is useless—why not have elite cavalry follow me and call on the defenders to come out and surrender?
translations.idiomatic: Wannian said, "Seizing me is useless—why not have elite cavalry follow me and call on the defenders to come out and surrender?

sentences.zh: 」賊以精騎五百擁萬年至城下，萬年大呼曰：「我被擒，誓必死。

translations.literal: " The bandits with five hundred elite cavalry escorted Wannian to the foot of the wall; Wannian shouted, "I have been captured and swear I must die.
translations.idiomatic: " The bandits with five hundred elite cavalry escorted Wannian to the foot of the wall; Wannian shouted, "I have been captured and swear I must die.

sentences.zh: 賊精銳盡在此，急發炮擊之，毋以我為念！

translations.literal: The bandits' elite troops are all here—fire cannon at once and do not think of me!
translations.idiomatic: The bandits' elite troops are all here—fire cannon at once and do not think of me!

sentences.zh: 」守將楊禦蕃不忍，萬年復頓足大呼，賊怒殺之。

translations.literal: " Garrison Commander Yang Yufan could not bear it; Wannian again stamped his feet and shouted; the bandits in anger killed him.
translations.idiomatic: " Garrison Commander Yang Yufan could not bear it; Wannian again stamped his feet and shouted; the bandits in anger killed him.

sentences.zh: 城上人見萬年已死，遂發駮，賊死過半。

translations.literal: Those on the wall saw Wannian was dead and then fired cannon; more than half the bandits died.
translations.idiomatic: Those on the wall saw Wannian was dead and then fired cannon; more than half the bandits died.

sentences.zh: 事聞，贈太常卿，賜祭葬，有司建祠，官一子。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, he was posthumously made Director of the Imperial Sacrifices, granted sacrificial burial, the local authorities built a shrine, and one son was granted office.
translations.idiomatic: When the matter was reported, he was posthumously made Director of the Imperial Sacrifices, granted sacrificial burial, the local authorities built a shrine, and one son was granted office.

sentences.zh: 秦三輔、王協中、吳世揚、張國輔、張奇功、熊奮渭、陳所聞

translations.literal: Qin Sanfu, Wang Xiezhong, Wu Shiyang, Zhang Guofu, Zhang Qigong, Xiong Fenwei, Chen Suowen
translations.idiomatic: Qin Sanfu, Wang Xiezhong, Wu Shiyang, Zhang Guofu, Zhang Qigong, Xiong Fenwei, Chen Suowen

sentences.zh: 初，賊掠新城，知縣秦三輔、訓導王協中禦之，並死。

translations.literal: Initially, when bandits raided Xincheng, Magistrate Qin Sanfu and Instructor Wang Xiezhong resisted them and both died.
translations.idiomatic: Initially, when bandits raided Xincheng, Magistrate Qin Sanfu and Instructor Wang Xiezhong resisted them and both died.

sentences.zh: 其陷黃縣，知縣吳世揚罵賊死，縣丞張國輔、參將張奇功、守備熊奮渭皆力戰死。

translations.literal: When they took Huang County, Magistrate Wu Shiyang cursed the bandits and died; Assistant Magistrate Zhang Guofu, Regional Commander Zhang Qigong, and Garrison Commander Xiong Fenwei all died fighting.
translations.idiomatic: When they took Huang County, Magistrate Wu Shiyang cursed the bandits and died; Assistant Magistrate Zhang Guofu, Regional Commander Zhang Qigong, and Garrison Commander Xiong Fenwei all died fighting.

sentences.zh: 陷平度，知州陳所聞自縊死。

translations.literal: When Pingdu fell, Prefect Chen Suowen hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: When Pingdu fell, Prefect Chen Suowen hanged himself.

sentences.zh: 三輔、世揚贈光祿少卿，所聞贈太僕少卿，並賜祭葬，建祠，蔭子。

translations.literal: Sanfu and Shiyang were posthumously made Vice Directors of the Imperial Household; Suowen was posthumously made Vice Director of the Imperial Stud; all were granted sacrificial burial, shrines were built, and sons were granted hereditary privilege.
translations.idiomatic: Sanfu and Shiyang were posthumously made Vice Directors of the Imperial Household; Suowen was posthumously made Vice Director of the Imperial Stud; all were granted sacrificial burial, shrines were built, and sons were granted hereditary privilege.

sentences.zh: 協中、國輔、奇功亦贈恤有差。

translations.literal: Xiezhong, Guofu, and Qigong also received posthumous compensation in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Xiezhong, Guofu, and Qigong also received posthumous compensation in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 三輔，三原人。

translations.literal: Sanfu was a native of Sanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Sanfu came from Sanyuan.

sentences.zh: 世揚，洛陽人。

translations.literal: Shiyang was a native of Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Shiyang came from Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 所聞，畿輔人。

translations.literal: Suowen was a native of the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: Suowen came from the capital region.

sentences.zh: 並起家乙榜。

translations.literal: All began their careers through the second-rank examination list.
translations.idiomatic: All began their careers through the second-rank examination list.

sentences.zh: 張瑤，蓬萊人。

translations.literal: Zhang Yao was a native of Penglai.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yao came from Penglai.

sentences.zh: 天啟五年進士。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Tianqi he passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: He became a jinshi in the fifth year of Tianqi.

sentences.zh: 授開封府推官，絕請寄，抑豪強，吏民畏如神。

translations.literal: He was appointed Kaifeng Prefecture reviewing official, refused all patronage requests, suppressed powerful families, and officials and people feared him as a god.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Kaifeng Prefecture reviewing official, refused all patronage requests, suppressed powerful families, and officials and people feared him as a god.

sentences.zh: 崇禎四年行取入都，吏科宋鳴梧力援宋玫為給事，而抑瑤，授府同知。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Chongzhen he was selected for the capital; Supervising Secretary Song Mingwu strongly supported Song Mei for supervising secretary and suppressed Yao, who was made prefectural vice commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Chongzhen he was selected for the capital; Supervising Secretary Song Mingwu strongly supported Song Mei for supervising secretary and suppressed Yao, who was made prefectural vice commissioner.

sentences.zh: 瑤怒，疏摭玫行賄狀。

translations.literal: Yao in anger submitted a memorial detailing Mei's bribery.
translations.idiomatic: Yao in anger submitted a memorial detailing Mei's bribery.

sentences.zh: 吏部尚書閔洪學劾瑤饋遺奔競，鳴梧復極論之，謫河州判官，未赴。

translations.literal: Ministry of Personnel Minister Min Hongxue impeached Yao for gifts and scrambling for office; Mingwu again argued fiercely; Yao was demoted to Hezhou Assistant Magistrate and had not yet taken up the post.
translations.idiomatic: Ministry of Personnel Minister Min Hongxue impeached Yao for gifts and scrambling for office; Mingwu again argued fiercely; Yao was demoted to Hezhou Assistant Magistrate and had not yet taken up the post.

sentences.zh: 明年正月，李九成等逼登州，瑤率家眾登陴拒守。

translations.literal: In the first month of the next year Li Jiucheng and others pressed Dengzhou; Yao led his household onto the battlements to resist.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the next year Li Jiucheng and others pressed Dengzhou; Yao led his household onto the battlements to resist.

sentences.zh: 城陷，瑤猶揮石奮擊。

translations.literal: When the city fell Yao still hurled stones and fought fiercely.
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell Yao still hurled stones and fought fiercely.

sentences.zh: 賊擁執之，大罵不屈，被殺。

translations.literal: The bandits seized him in a crowd; he cursed loudly and would not yield and was killed.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits seized him in a crowd; he cursed loudly and would not yield and was killed.

sentences.zh: 妻女四人並投井死。

translations.literal: His wife and four daughters all threw themselves into a well and died.
translations.idiomatic: His wife and four daughters all threw themselves into a well and died.

sentences.zh: 贈光祿少卿。

translations.literal: He was posthumously made Vice Director of the Imperial Household.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Vice Director of the Imperial Household.

sentences.zh: 王與夔、張儼然、張聯臺、蔣時行

translations.literal: Wang Yuqi, Zhang Yiran, Zhang Liangtai, Jiang Shixing
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yuqi, Zhang Yiran, Zhang Liangtai, Jiang Shixing

sentences.zh: 先是，賊陷新城，舉人王與夔、張儼然死之。

translations.literal: Earlier, when bandits took Xincheng, provincial graduates Wang Yuqi and Zhang Yiran died.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when bandits took Xincheng, provincial graduates Wang Yuqi and Zhang Yiran died.

sentences.zh: 其陷他縣者，貢生張聯臺、蔣時行亦死之。

translations.literal: When other counties fell, tribute students Zhang Liangtai and Jiang Shixing also died.
translations.idiomatic: When other counties fell, tribute students Zhang Liangtai and Jiang Shixing also died.

sentences.zh: 皆格於例，不獲旌。

translations.literal: All were blocked by precedent and received no commendation.
translations.idiomatic: All were blocked by precedent and received no commendation.

sentences.zh: 禮部侍郎陳子壯上言：「舉貢死難，無恤典，舊制也。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Rites Chen Zizhuang submitted a memorial, saying, "Provincial graduates and tribute students who die in calamity receive no compensation—this is old regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister of Rites Chen Zizhuang submitted a memorial, saying, "Provincial graduates and tribute students who die in calamity receive no compensation—this is old regulation.

sentences.zh: 然名既登於天府，恩獨後於流官，九泉之下，能無怨恫。

translations.literal: Yet their names are already recorded in the imperial registry while favor alone lags behind regular officials—in the realm below, how can there be no resentment?
translations.idiomatic: Yet their names are already recorded in the imperial registry while favor alone lags behind regular officials—in the realm below, how can there be no resentment?

sentences.zh: 比者，武舉李調禦賊捐軀，已蒙贈恤。

translations.literal: Recently, military examination graduate Li Diao resisted bandits and gave his life and has already received posthumous compensation.
translations.idiomatic: Recently, military examination graduate Li Diao resisted bandits and gave his life and has already received posthumous compensation.

sentences.zh: 武途如此，文儒安得獨遺。

translations.literal: If the military path is treated thus, how can literary scholars alone be left out?
translations.idiomatic: If the military path is treated thus, how can literary scholars alone be left out?

sentences.zh: 乞量贈一官，永為定制。

translations.literal: I beg that an office be granted in proportion and made a permanent regulation.
translations.idiomatic: I beg that an office be granted in proportion and made a permanent regulation.

sentences.zh: 」可之。

translations.literal: " Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: " Approval was granted.

sentences.zh: 乃贈輿夔、儼然宛平知縣，聯臺、時行順天府教授。

translations.literal: Yuqi and Yiran were then posthumously made magistrates of Wanping; Liangtai and Shixing were made professors of Shuntian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yuqi and Yiran were then posthumously made magistrates of Wanping; Liangtai and Shixing were made professors of Shuntian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 其後地方死難，若舉人李讓、吳之秀、賈煜、張慶雲，貢生張茂貞、張茂恂，皆贈官如前制。

translations.literal: Thereafter, local men who died in calamity, such as provincial graduates Li Rang, Wu Zhixiu, Jia Yu, and Zhang Qingyun and tribute students Zhang Maozhen and Zhang Maoxun, all received posthumous offices under the same regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, local men who died in calamity, such as provincial graduates Li Rang, Wu Zhixiu, Jia Yu, and Zhang Qingyun and tribute students Zhang Maozhen and Zhang Maoxun, all received posthumous offices under the same regulation.

sentences.zh: 何天衢

translations.literal: He Tianqu
translations.idiomatic: He Tianqu

sentences.zh: 何天衢，字升宇，阿迷州人。

translations.literal: He Tianqu, style name Shengyu, was a native of Ami Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He Tianqu, whose style was Shengyu, came from Ami Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 有勇略，土酋普名聲招為頭目，使駐三鄉。

translations.literal: He had courage and strategy; native chieftain Pu Mingsheng recruited him as a headman and stationed him at Sanxiang.
translations.idiomatic: He had courage and strategy; native chieftain Pu Mingsheng recruited him as a headman and stationed him at Sanxiang.

sentences.zh: 崇禎三年，名聲反，謀出三路兵，至昆明會戰。

translations.literal: In the third year of Chongzhen, Mingsheng rebelled and planned to send three routes of troops to meet in battle at Kunming.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Chongzhen, Mingsheng rebelled and planned to send three routes of troops to meet in battle at Kunming.

sentences.zh: 令天衢自維摩羅平入，以炮手三百人助之。

translations.literal: He ordered Tianqu to enter from Weimo and Luoping and gave him three hundred artillerymen to assist.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Tianqu to enter from Weimo and Luoping and gave him three hundred artillerymen to assist.

sentences.zh: 天衢慨然曰：「此大丈夫報國秋也，吾豈為逆賊用哉！

translations.literal: Tianqu said with emotion, "This is the moment for a great man to repay the state—how could I be used by rebels!
translations.idiomatic: Tianqu said with emotion, "This is the moment for a great man to repay the state—how could I be used by rebels!

sentences.zh: 」坑殺炮手數十人，率眾歸附，署維摩州同知李嗣泌開城納之。

translations.literal: " He buried and killed several dozen artillerymen, led his followers to submit, and Acting Weimo Vice Commissioner Li Sibì opened the city to receive him.
translations.idiomatic: " He buried and killed several dozen artillerymen, led his followers to submit, and Acting Weimo Vice Commissioner Li Sibì opened the city to receive him.

sentences.zh: 名聲已陷彌勒，聞大懼，急撤兩路兵歸。

translations.literal: Mingsheng had already taken Mile; hearing this he was greatly afraid and urgently withdrew the two other routes.
translations.idiomatic: Mingsheng had already taken Mile; hearing this he was greatly afraid and urgently withdrew the two other routes.

sentences.zh: 巡撫王伉上其事，授為守備。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator Wang Kang reported the matter and Tianqu was appointed garrison commander.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Wang Kang reported the matter and Tianqu was appointed garrison commander.

sentences.zh: 後數與嗣泌進剿有功。

translations.literal: Later he repeatedly joined Sibì in advance suppression with merit.
translations.idiomatic: Later he repeatedly joined Sibì in advance suppression with merit.

sentences.zh: 及名聲死，妻萬氏代領其眾，屢攻天衢。

translations.literal: When Mingsheng died, his wife Lady Wan took command of his followers and repeatedly attacked Tianqu.
translations.idiomatic: When Mingsheng died, his wife Lady Wan took command of his followers and repeatedly attacked Tianqu.

sentences.zh: 天衢屢挫之，錄功，進參將。

translations.literal: Tianqu repeatedly defeated her; his merit was recorded and he was promoted to regimental commander.
translations.idiomatic: Tianqu repeatedly defeated her; his merit was recorded and he was promoted to regimental commander.

sentences.zh: 十三年擢副總兵。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was promoted to vice regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was promoted to vice regional commander.

sentences.zh: 萬氏贅沙定洲為婿，益以南安兵，且厚賂黔國公用事者，令毀天衢。

translations.literal: Lady Wan took Sha Dingzhou as son-in-law, added Nan'an troops, and also bribed those in power at the Qian Principality to destroy Tianqu.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Wan took Sha Dingzhou as son-in-law, added Nan'an troops, and also bribed those in power at the Qian Principality to destroy Tianqu.

sentences.zh: 天衢請兵餉皆不應，賊悉力攻之，食盡，舉家自焚死。

translations.literal: Tianqu's requests for troops and provisions went unanswered; bandits attacked with all their strength; food ran out and the whole household burned themselves to death.
translations.idiomatic: Tianqu's requests for troops and provisions went unanswered; bandits attacked with all their strength; food ran out and the whole household burned themselves to death.

sentences.zh: 楊於陛

translations.literal: Yang Yubi
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yubi

sentences.zh: 初，名聲之亂，有楊於陛者，劍州人。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Mingsheng's rebellion there was Yang Yubi, a native of Jian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Mingsheng's rebellion there was Yang Yubi of Jian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 舉於鄉。

translations.literal: He passed the provincial examination.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the provincial examination.

sentences.zh: 歷官武定府同知。

translations.literal: He served as Assistant Prefect of Wuding Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He served as Assistant Prefect of Wuding Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 巡撫伉令監紀軍事，兵敗被執，死之。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator Kang ordered him to supervise military affairs; the army was defeated, he was captured, and died.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Kang ordered him to supervise military affairs; the army was defeated, he was captured, and died.

sentences.zh: 贈太僕少卿，建祠曰精忠。

translations.literal: He was posthumously made Vice Director of the Imperial Stud and a shrine called Jingzhong was built.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Vice Director of the Imperial Stud and a shrine called Jingzhong was built.
